title: Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior
description:
Vaga homeoffice - mas para profissionais de São Paulo ou Curitiba, pois pode ser necessário atuação presencial em alguns eventos.


Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior , com domínio técnico sólido em ambiente Azure e forte capacidade de atuação estratégica junto a áreas de negócio e liderança executiva.

O(a) profissional será responsável por desenhar e implementar arquiteturas de dados robustas e escaláveis , atuar de forma consultiva com diferentes áreas da companhia, além de ser um ponto de apoio técnico e estratégico para o time de dados.

Responsabilidades

  • Elaborar e manter arquiteturas de dados na plataforma Azure , garantindo segurança, escalabilidade e performance.
  • Atuar com Azure Data Factory (ADF) , Synapse Analytics e Databricks , dominando integrações e fluxos de dados entre essas tecnologias.
  • Realizar code reviews e garantir a qualidade técnica das entregas.
  • Participar ativamente de reuniões com áreas de negócio , compreendendo necessidades e traduzindo-as em soluções técnicas eficientes.
  • Conduzir agendas técnicas e de alinhamento com o time de engenharia de dados e demais stakeholders.
  • Apoiar o time técnico em decisões estratégicas, atuando como referência técnica e ponto de suporte avançado .
  • Preparar e apresentar materiais técnicos e executivos , com comunicação clara, objetiva e aderente ao público-alvo.
  • Compreender as dificuldades e desafios do negócio , propondo soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis.

Requisitos Essenciais

  • Domínio avançado em Azure , com forte experiência em ADF, Synapse e Databricks .
  • Conhecimento profundo em PySpark .
  • Experiência em integração entre tecnologias de dados e desenho de arquitetura de dados .
  • Habilidade para realizar code review e garantir boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma colaborativa e consultiva com times técnicos e de negócio.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar fora do horário padrão , quando necessário.
  • Forte senso de responsabilidade, proatividade e resiliência — o profissional será bastante desafiado e exigido tecnicamente.
  • Excelente comunicação , com capacidade de traduzir conceitos técnicos complexos de forma clara para executivos e diretores.
  • Experiência em reuniões com alta liderança e na elaboração de apresentações executivas .

Desejável

  • Conhecimento em Python , Spark , SQL .
  • Experiência com EventHubs ou Kafka .
  • Familiaridade com DevOps , Inteligência Artificial (IA) e Machine Learning (ML) .
  • Experiência ou entendimento em Governança de Dados .

Perfil Comportamental

  • Proatividade e senso de dono , atuando com autonomia e responsabilidade.
  • Resiliência e equilíbrio emocional frente a demandas complexas e prazos desafiadores.
  • Boa comunicação interpessoal e habilidade para transitar entre áreas técnicas e executivas.
  • Espírito colaborativo e capacidade de trabalhar em equipe multidisciplinar.

title: Sales Account Executive (Fluent English)
description:
Sales Account Executive – U.S. Market (Remote)


At Bluedot BPO Solutions, we connect top Brazilian talent with global companies that value performance, consistency, and growth. With over 10 years of experience in outsourcing and staff augmentation, we provide a structured and high-performance environment for sales professionals who aim to grow internationally. This position is for sales professionals ready to lead B2B prospecting in the U.S. market , with real opportunities for development, recognition, and long-term stability.


What We Offer

  • Monthly compensation of R$5,000 reais + USD-based bonuses ;
  • 100% remote work, Monday to Friday (1 p.m. – 10 p.m. BRT);
  • Exposure to U.S. executive-level sales culture;
  • Intensive onboarding (3–5 weeks) and internal certifications.


What You’ll Do

  • Prospect and qualify B2B leads through cold calls, emails, and LinkedIn outreach;
  • Track key sales metrics and pipeline performance;
  • Conduct meetings and present solutions to U.S.-based executives;
  • Collaborate with Business Development and CRM teams for process improvement;
  • Maintain a disciplined, results-driven sales rhythm.


What We’re Looking For

  • 1–3 years of experience in Business Sales / Outbound reach ;
  • Fluent English (C1+) – clear, natural communication in meetings;
  • Familiar with SPIN Selling, BANT , or other sales frameworks;
  • Tech-savvy, organized, multitasker, and highly reliable;
  • Comfortable working under goals and fast-paced environments.

title: Junior Sales Executive (Fluent English)
description:
Sales Account Executive Junior – U.S. Market Sales Support (Remote)


At Bluedot, we help bilingual Brazilian professionals build global careers.

If you speak fluent English, are passionate about sales, and thrive in fast-paced environments, this is your opportunity to develop in international B2B sales with real mentorship and structured growth.


What We Offer

  • Monthly compensation of R$4,000 reais ;
  • 100% remote position, Monday to Friday (1 p.m. – 10 p.m. BRT);
  • Structured training and real career advancement opportunities;
  • Daily exposure to U.S. corporate culture.


What You’ll Do

  • Support outbound sales campaigns (email, LinkedIn, calls);
  • Qualify B2B leads and maintain an updated pipeline;
  • Prepare and follow up on sales meetings and materials;
  • Identify opportunities within U.S. executive networks;
  • Manage sales data in CRM tools (HubSpot, Sales Navigator).


What We’re Looking For

  • 1–3 years of experience in B2B outbound sales or lead generation ;
  • Fluent English (C1+) – strong communication in calls and emails;
  • Organized, focused, and eager to learn;
  • Tech-savvy and results-oriented;
  • Motivated to build a long-term career in global sales .

title: SAP Data Migration Lead Consultant
description:
ABOUT US

Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.



The ROLE

We are recruiting talented and motivated individuals to join our team delivering data projects for clients across the globe. As a lead data migration consultant at Syniti, you will be responsible for managing a team of migration consultants on all aspects of data work for a process area/workstream. You will work closely with functional consultants and key customer resources, gathering requirements through workshops, building conversion objects, and driving your team’s value through all data project phases. You will be responsible for making sure that your team uses your data skills and the Syniti data management platform to assess and iterate through design, build, and deployment, ensuring that the highest customer value is derived from your assigned objects. As a lead member of a Syniti Data Migration team, you will execute against the best practices for successful business transformation and become skilled in the strongest platform to meet all of our customer’s needs.


This role has been designated as a remote position, allowing qualified talent throughout the listed country to be considered for the opportunity.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

After an initial training period, a Lead Data Migration Consultant will be expected to:


  • Demonstrate a strong understanding of Syniti’s Data Migration methodology.
  • Demonstrate strong proficiency in Syniti’s tools, working to prescribed development standards.
  • Good understanding of business processes for one or more assigned functional area, and the ability to quickly learn about new areas.
  • Effectively manage a small team of data migration consultants, to meet assigned responsibilities against the overall project plan.
  • Demonstrate a strong knowledge of underlying technical data structures and definitions of assigned functional process area.
  • Develop data migration rules and reports in the Syniti’s tools as per supplied specification.
  • Evaluate and contribute to ongoing data migration design for assigned process area through data analysis, reporting and collaboration with on-site Syniti and client colleagues.
  • Create and maintain data load programs.
  • Maintain related documentation and clearly communicate status to Syniti Team Leadership and customer PMO.
  • Execution of end-to-end data loads and reconciliations.
  • Support and mentor junior colleagues.



WHAT IT TAKES

  • Degree level qualification in Computer Science (or other technology related field).
  • Experience in ETL / Data Migration / Data Quality / Data Analysis.
  • Experience managing resources to deliver a collective goal/responsibility.
  • Functional ERP experience.
  • Project experience across multiple ERP implementations.
  • Database experience - SQL Server, Oracle etc.
  • Customer facing skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Willingness to travel according to project requirements up to 100%.



WHAT WE OFFER

  • Autonomy and Trust: Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, with minimal micromanagement.
  • Growth Opportunities: We are growing rapidly, offering you the chance to grow with us, shape our journey, and share in our success story.
  • Collaborative Support: We value collaboration and support each other, ensuring you won't stand alone in your endeavors.
  • Diversity of Stories: Genuine interest in your unique story and journey. We celebrate individual achievements and want to hear everyone's story.
  • Recognition: We appreciate and celebrate individual achievements, acknowledging the contribution of each team member.
  • Open Organization: We embrace an open and inclusive culture, where hierarchies are minimized, and access is ensured across the board. Everyone is valued, and ideas are welcomed.

As a lead data migration consultant at Syniti, you will be responsible for managing a team of migration consultants on all aspects of data work for a process area/workstream. You will be responsible for making sure that your team uses your data skills and the Syniti data management platform to assess and iterate through design, build, and deployment, ensuring that the highest customer value is derived from your assigned objects. As a lead member of a Syniti Data Migration team, you will execute against the best practices for successful business transformation and become skilled in the strongest platform to meet all of our customer’s needs.


This role has been designated as a remote position, allowing qualified talent throughout the listed country to be considered for the opportunity.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

After an initial training period, a Lead Data Migration Consultant will be expected to:


  • Demonstrate a strong understanding of Syniti’s Data Migration methodology.
  • Demonstrate strong proficiency in Syniti’s tools, working to prescribed development standards.
  • Good understanding of business processes for one or more assigned functional area, and the ability to quickly learn about new areas.
  • Effectively manage a small team of data migration consultants, to meet assigned responsibilities against the overall project plan.
  • Demonstrate a strong knowledge of underlying technical data structures and definitions of assigned functional process area.
  • Develop data migration rules and reports in the Syniti’s tools as per supplied specification.

  • Maintain related documentation and clearly communicate status to Syniti Team Leadership and customer PMO.

  • Degree level qualification in Computer Science (or other technology related field).
  • Experience in ETL / Data Migration / Data Quality / Data Analysis.
  • Experience managing resources to deliver a collective goal/responsibility.
  • Functional ERP experience.
  • Project experience across multiple ERP implementations.
  • Database experience - SQL Server, Oracle etc.
  • Customer facing skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Willingness to travel according to project requirements up to 100%.



WHAT WE OFFER

  • Autonomy and Trust: Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, with minimal micromanagement.

  • Diversity of Stories: Genuine interest in your unique story and journey. We celebrate individual achievements and want to hear everyone's story.
  • Recognition: We appreciate and celebrate individual achievements, acknowledging the contribution of each team member.

description:

Eviden is a company of the Atos Group with an annual revenue of over €5 billion.



R&D Developer - Performance Analysis and Scalability

100% Home Office

The candidate will be part of a research and development group working on the software development group of next generation high-performance architectures.



Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate in the creation and improvement of products, from conception to implementation.
  • Conduct tests to ensure that products meet quality standards and function as expected.
  • Work with multidisciplinary teams to ensure that R&D projects align with the company's objectives.
  • Collaborate on a R&D project using Agile methodologies.
  • Production of proper documentation related to the projects.


Requirements:

  • Solid knowledge of the Linux operating system, especially RedHat Enterprise Linux (RHEL).
  • Experience in programming with Python 3, including file handling, YAML/Jinja (desired), and testing (unittest/pytest).
  • Basic knowledge of HPC environments and understanding of cluster architecture.
  • Familiarity with management services, such as DHCP, DNS, etc.
  • Understanding of "configuration as a code"
  • Experience with containers (docker/podman) and GIT.
  • Bachelor degree in Computer Sciences or related STEM fields.
  • Advanced/Fluent English to participate in frequent meetings with international teams.


Desired Requirements:

  • Master and/or Ph.D. in Computer Science or related fields.
  • Experience with Ansible, Jenkins (CI/CD), and monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana).

title: Bolsista Doutor - Digital Care 2 You- Aplicação de Inteligência Artificial na Jornada do paciente | Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial - IEL/PR
description:
A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

O programa oferece bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses, promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado, ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.

Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a aplicação prática do conhecimento científico, favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico. A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências, e potencializa a capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável.


Sobre a Oportunidade:

Vem transformar com a gente!

A Digital Care 2 You é uma healthtech comprometida com a transformação digital da saúde pública e suplementar por meio da inovação responsável. Atuamos com soluções baseadas em Inteligência Artificial, Big Data e interoperabilidade de sistemas, com foco em segurança clínica, ética, conformidade e impacto real na jornada do paciente.

Nosso propósito é claro: ampliar o acesso, a precisão e a qualidade do cuidado por meio da tecnologia, sempre respeitando os princípios éticos e os marcos legais da área da saúde.


Formação Acadêmica:

Doutorado completo nas áreas de Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Bioinformática, Inteligência Artificial Aplicada, áreas afins.

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.


Projeto: Aplicação de Inteligência Artificial na Jornada do paciente.


Principais Atividades:

· Mapeamento e análise de requisitos com times multiprofissionais.

· Integração de dados.

· Desenvolvimento e validação de modelos de IA em saúde.

· Criação de ferramentas automatizadas.

· Avaliação contínua de impacto, performance e acurácia dos modelos de IA.

· Elaboração de documentação técnica e treinamentos para equipes de tecnologia e saúde.

· Garantia de segurança, anonimização, ética e conformidade com a LGPD e boas práticas de IA.


Conhecimento necessário:

· Domínio de Python, R, Java Script, SQL, React, Node ou similares e bibliotecas de IA.

· Experiência com integração de dados em saúde e padrões de interoperabilidade.

· Portfólio técnico ou publicações científicas em projetos de IA em saúde.

· Conhecimento da LGPD e princípios éticos para uso de IA.

Conhecimento desejável:

· Experiência com projetos na área de saúde.

· Participação em iniciativas nacionais ou internacionais de interoperabilidade.

· Certificações técnicas.

· Idioma: Inglês.


Valor da bolsa (mensal): Bolsista (Doutor) R$ 5.000 – Programa Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial

Formato de trabalho: Remoto

Local: Remoto

Soft Skills: Autogestão, Pensamento crítico, Criatividade, Organização.

Sobre a Oportunidade:

Vem transformar com a gente!

A Digital Care 2 You é uma healthtech comprometida com a transformação digital da saúde pública e suplementar por meio da inovação responsável. Nosso propósito é claro: ampliar o acesso, a precisão e a qualidade do cuidado por meio da tecnologia, sempre respeitando os princípios éticos e os marcos legais da área da saúde.


Formação Acadêmica:

Doutorado completo nas áreas de Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Bioinformática, Inteligência Artificial Aplicada, áreas afins.

Defesa da tese há, no máximo, 5 anos.

Principais Atividades:

· Mapeamento e análise de requisitos com times multiprofissionais.

· Integração de dados.

· Desenvolvimento e validação de modelos de IA em saúde.

· Criação de ferramentas automatizadas.

· Avaliação contínua de impacto, performance e acurácia dos modelos de IA.

· Elaboração de documentação técnica e treinamentos para equipes de tecnologia e saúde.

· Garantia de segurança, anonimização, ética e conformidade com a LGPD e boas práticas de IA.

title: Engenheiros de IA
description:
Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade para Engenheiros de IA experientes com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Pesquisar, desenvolver e implementar metodologias avançadas de Large Language Models (LLMs) para criação de produtos de dados baseados em IA generativa.

• Desenvolver e aprimorar técnicas de Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), combinando embeddings e bancos de vetores para melhorar precisão e relevância das respostas dos modelos.

• Aplicar técnicas de segurança e governança para IA generativa, mitigando alucinações, viés e riscos éticos no uso de LLMs.

• Automatizar e monitorar o desempenho de modelos generativos em produção, utilizando frameworks de MLOps e ferramentas de observabilidade de IA.

• Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com times de engenharia, produto e negócio para transformar desafios empresariais em soluções escaláveis baseadas em IA generativa.

Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

• Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento e aplicação de LLMs e fluxos agênticos.

• Forte domínio de Python, frameworks como LangGraph, PydanticAI, LlamaIndex, e ferramentas de MLOps para produção de modelos generativos.

• Proficiência em Vector Databases (FAISS, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Milvus, Pinecone) e pipelines de dados escaláveis.

• Conhecimento avançado em Machine Learning, Deep Learning e Fine-Tuning de modelos fundacionais.

• Experiência com deploy e monitoramento de modelos em produção, incluindo técnicas de inferência eficiente, caching e otimização.

• Familiaridade com conceitos de governança, segurança e alinhamento de modelos generativos.

Minimum Education:

  • Ensino superior completo.
  • Inglês Fluente

title: Arquiteto de Dados III
description:
Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:

Esta pessoa irá contribuir com os processos de qualidade em tecnologia do Grupo Fleury por meio de técnicas, ferramentas e parceria entre os times de Digital e Tech da empresa. Fazemos uso da tecnologia e inovação para gerar a movimentação que o mercado precisa. Somos reconhecidos pelo nosso propósito: cuidar das pessoas e buscamos aqueles que compartilham desse ideal.

Deseja trabalhar em um lugar que concilie desafio, agilidade e inovação? Aqui é o lugar.


Principais atividades:

• Desenvolvimento e Evolução de Plataformas: Projetar, desenvolver e evoluir plataformas de dados robustas e escaláveis.

• Ideação e Implementação de Arquiteturas: Liderar a ideação e implementação de novas arquiteturas de dados.

• Automação e Escalabilidade: Desenvolver pipelines de dados automatizados e escaláveis.

• Documentação e Conhecimento: Documentar processos e sistemas de forma detalhada.

• Governança e Qualidade de Dados: Implementar e monitorar práticas de governança de dados.

• Relatórios e Comunicação: Criar relatórios técnicos detalhados e apresentar para stakeholders.

• Colaboração Interdisciplinar: Trabalhar com equipes de ciência de dados e engenharia de dados para entender requisitos.

• Avaliar e incorporar novas tecnologias em conjunto com Arquitetura.

• Mentorar engenheiros de dados juniores e plenos.

• Propor melhorias contínuas nos processos e ferramentas.



Buscamos alguém que apresente:

Pós-graduação, Mestrado ou Doutorado em Ciência da Computação, Ciência de Dados, Estatística, Engenharia ou área correlata.

Domina os seguintes itens:

• Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Ferramentas de IaC como Terraform, Plumini e CloudFormation.

• Computação em Nuvem: Experiência com AWS, incluindo serviços como EC2, S3, Lambda, Redshift, EMR, Glue, Athena e SageMaker.

• Ferramentas de CDC: Conhecimento e uso de ferramentas de CDC.

• Armazenamento e Arquitetura de Dados: Implementação de data lakehouse e estruturas Medallion.

• Modelos de Machine Learning em produção: Experiência no deploy e monitoramento de modelos.

• Ferramentas de ETL e Orquestração: Experiência com Apache Airflow, dbt e outras ferramentas.

• Experiência com Databricks.

• Linguagens de Programação: Proficiência em Python e SQL.

• Boas Práticas de Engenharia de Software: Aplicação de princípios de engenharia de software, como controle de versão, testes automatizados, integração contínua e deploy contínuo (CI/CD).

• Governança de Dados: Experiência com políticas de governança de dados, gestão de dados sensíveis e privados, e catálogos de dados.

• Experiência em processar e gerenciar grandes volumes de dados (Terabytes).

• Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais.

• Inglês intermediário (leitura técnica).

• Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de projetos.

• Habilidade para criar e apresentar relatórios técnicos e gerenciais.

• Visão estratégica de negócios e da necessidade dos times de dados



Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.

• Trabalho em equipe

• Adaptabilidade

• Flexibilidade

• Agilidade

• Curiosidade

• Visão sistêmica e analítica

• Disciplina

• Relacionamento Interpessoal

• Empatia com a lógica do cliente

• Capacidade de tomar decisões

• Gestão inteligente do tempo

• Capacidade de agir sob pressão

title: Arquiteto de Dados III
description:
Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:

Esta pessoa irá contribuir com os processos de qualidade em tecnologia do Grupo Fleury por meio de técnicas, ferramentas e parceria entre os times de Digital e Tech da empresa. Fazemos uso da tecnologia e inovação para gerar a movimentação que o mercado precisa. Somos reconhecidos pelo nosso propósito: cuidar das pessoas e buscamos aqueles que compartilham desse ideal.

Deseja trabalhar em um lugar que concilie desafio, agilidade e inovação? Aqui é o lugar.


Principais atividades:

• Desenvolvimento e Evolução de Plataformas: Projetar, desenvolver e evoluir plataformas de dados robustas e escaláveis.

• Ideação e Implementação de Arquiteturas: Liderar a ideação e implementação de novas arquiteturas de dados.

• Automação e Escalabilidade: Desenvolver pipelines de dados automatizados e escaláveis.

• Documentação e Conhecimento: Documentar processos e sistemas de forma detalhada.

• Governança e Qualidade de Dados: Implementar e monitorar práticas de governança de dados.

• Relatórios e Comunicação: Criar relatórios técnicos detalhados e apresentar para stakeholders.

• Colaboração Interdisciplinar: Trabalhar com equipes de ciência de dados e engenharia de dados para entender requisitos.

• Avaliar e incorporar novas tecnologias em conjunto com Arquitetura.

• Mentorar engenheiros de dados juniores e plenos.

• Propor melhorias contínuas nos processos e ferramentas.



Buscamos alguém que apresente:

Pós-graduação, Mestrado ou Doutorado em Ciência da Computação, Ciência de Dados, Estatística, Engenharia ou área correlata.

Domina os seguintes itens:

• Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Ferramentas de IaC como Terraform, Plumini e CloudFormation.

• Computação em Nuvem: Experiência com AWS, incluindo serviços como EC2, S3, Lambda, Redshift, EMR, Glue, Athena e SageMaker.

• Ferramentas de CDC: Conhecimento e uso de ferramentas de CDC.

• Armazenamento e Arquitetura de Dados: Implementação de data lakehouse e estruturas Medallion.

• Modelos de Machine Learning em produção: Experiência no deploy e monitoramento de modelos.

• Ferramentas de ETL e Orquestração: Experiência com Apache Airflow, dbt e outras ferramentas.

• Experiência com Databricks.

• Linguagens de Programação: Proficiência em Python e SQL.

• Boas Práticas de Engenharia de Software: Aplicação de princípios de engenharia de software, como controle de versão, testes automatizados, integração contínua e deploy contínuo (CI/CD).

• Governança de Dados: Experiência com políticas de governança de dados, gestão de dados sensíveis e privados, e catálogos de dados.

• Experiência em processar e gerenciar grandes volumes de dados (Terabytes).

• Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais.

• Inglês intermediário (leitura técnica).

• Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de projetos.

• Habilidade para criar e apresentar relatórios técnicos e gerenciais.

• Visão estratégica de negócios e da necessidade dos times de dados

title: Customer Service Specialist
description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?

Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the week!


Job Title: Customer Service Specialist


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $840-$$1,400 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,680-$2,800 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10,5 - $17,5 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.


Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary :


The Customer Service Specialist will be responsible for providing exceptional customer support, resolving inquiries and complaints, managing customer accounts, and ensuring a positive customer experience across all communication channels.


Job Tasks :


  • Customer Support: Respond to customer inquiries via phone, email, chat, and social media in a timely and professional manner.
  • Problem Resolution: Identify customer issues, troubleshoot problems, and provide effective solutions or escalate when necessary.
  • Account Management: Update and maintain accurate customer records and account information in the system.
  • Product Knowledge: Maintain comprehensive knowledge of products and services to provide accurate information and guidance.
  • Communication: Build positive relationships with customers through empathetic and clear communication.
  • Reporting and Feedback: Document customer interactions, track recurring issues, and provide feedback to improve service quality.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream Job!

title: Project Integration Specialist - Brazil
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Project Integration Specialist - Brazil , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract.


In this role you will:

The Project Integration Specialist is responsible for overseeing the integration and coordination of various IT projects within the organization, ensuring that all components of the projects are aligned, executed efficiently, and meet the company's strategic objectives. This professional acts as a technical leader, advisor and mentor, ensuring the cohesion and success of integration projects.


Main Responsibilities:

  • Leadership and Technical Consulting: Acting as a technical lead to ensure that project implementations are aligned with architectural design, guiding cross-functional teams, and fostering communication and collaboration among all stakeholders.
  • End-to-End Solution Design: Develop and implement comprehensive integration plans for IT projects. Assess the compatibility and interoperability of different systems and technologies through thorough testing and evaluation.
  • Project and Resource Management: Plan and manage the timelines and deliverables of integration projects. Allocate and manage resources effectively, including budgeting and staffing. Monitor project progress and performance, ensuring adherence to timelines and budget.
  • Technology Selection and Validation: Conduct technical assessments and feasibility studies for new integration projects to determine the best approach and resources needed. Stay up-to-date on emerging technologies and industry trends.
  • Risk Management: Identify and resolve integration issues and technical challenges through troubleshooting and collaboration with technical teams. Conduct risk assessments and develop mitigation strategies to ensure projects stay on track.
  • Governance and Compliance: Ensure compliance with industry standards and best practices throughout the integration process.
  • Documentation and Continuous Improvement: Prepare and maintain comprehensive project documentation, including integration plans, status reports, and risk assessments. Drive continuous improvement in integration processes and methodologies by analyzing project results and implementing feedback.

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills):

  • Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in IT project management , integration, or related field.
  • Systems Integration: Experience with a variety of integration tools and platforms (e.g., middleware, APIs) to facilitate the integration of projects, configuring and maintaining them. Experience in designing integrations between data systems and other enterprise platforms (e.g., ERPs such as SAP, CRMs).
  • Architecture: Strong understanding of IT infrastructure, networking, and software development. Experience with software architecture design, including microservices, SOA (Service-Oriented Architecture), and cloud-based architectures.
  • Systems and Tools: Use of integration tools and platforms. Implementation and management of systems to track and report metrics of integration projects, including the configuration of dashboards and monitoring tools.

Languages: Advanced English and/or French.


Soft Skills:

  • Communication and Influence: Exceptional ability to communicate complex technical concepts to varied audiences (technical, executive, business). Build strong relationships with stakeholders to ensure their needs are met and foster a collaborative environment.
  • Leadership and Collaboration: Ability to lead by example, working with cross-functional teams and building consensus among stakeholders.
  • Strategic Vision: Ability to think "in the big picture", aligning technological decisions with the company's long-term objectives.
  • Problem Solving: Proactive and analytical profile, engaged in identifying and solving complex challenges.

Organization and Focus: Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic and results-focused environment.


Differentials (Nice to Have):

  • Education: Master's degree in a related field.
  • Certifications: PMP (Project Management Professional) or other relevant certifications. Certifications in cloud architecture (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect, AWS Certified Solutions Architect).
  • Technologies: Experience with cloud computing and data integration. Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies.


Expected Skills:

  • Ensure that the needs of the business are aligned with the architectural vision.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions.
  • Ensure scalability/performance, security, and quality standards.
  • Identify opportunities for improvement in development processes and existing architecture.
  • Analyze the technological environment and seek possibilities for improvement and standardization in line with strategic planning.
  • Present to stakeholders how the architecture options will meet their needs.

● Health insurance

● Dental Plan

● Life insurance

● Transportation vouchers

● Meal/Food Voucher

● Childcare assistance

● Gympass

● TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

● Partnership with SESC

● Reimbursement of Certifications

● Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

● International experience opportunity

● Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

● Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

● TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

● Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility to build a TCS that respects each person. Our motto is “Inclusion without exception”. Join us and become a TCSer!

description:

Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.


O que Buscamos?


Arquiteto de sistemas .NET/Azure

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento .NET Core/.NET Framework;

  • Habilidades de apresentação técnica e voltada para o cliente com um alto grau de conforto com grandes e pequenos públicos;
  • Proficiência em arquitetura, desenvolvimento sistemas .Net Core e migração de soluções em nuvem;
  • Projetar, implementar e gerenciar pipelines de CI/CD para automatizar o ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de software;
  • Colaborar com as equipes de desenvolvimento, QA e operações para otimizar processos e melhorar a eficiência;
  • Monitorar e manter a saúde, desempenho e segurança de nossa infraestrutura e aplicações;
  • Desenvolver e manter infraestrutura como código usando ferramentas como Terraform, Ansible ou similares;
  • Solucionar problemas e resolver questões relacionadas ao deployment de aplicações e infraestrutura;
  • Implementar e gerenciar tecnologias como Docker e Kubernetes;
  • Garantir a conformidade com as melhores práticas e políticas de segurança;
  • Inglês Avançado

title: Senior Data Architect - Databricks (Remote)
description:
Olá!

A Aggrandize nasceu em 2015 com a missão de engrandecer pessoas e negócios . Guiados por valores como adaptabilidade, colaboração, foco no cliente e visão de dono, oferecemos soluções que transformam desafios em oportunidades.


Somos especialistas em Platform Engineering , Data Analytics , Modern Applications e Cybersecurity , sempre com o compromisso de impulsionar o crescimento e a inovação de nossos parceiros.


Nosso trabalho é mais do que tecnologia; é sobre potencializar resultados. Increase the power of your business .


Agora que você conhece a cultura Aggrandize, saiba mais sobre a oportunidade:


❇️ O seu papel no time:

  • Projetar e implementar arquiteturas de dados escaláveis e modernas (Lakehouse, Delta Lake, Medallion).
  • Colaborar com equipes de negócio e tecnologia para alinhar soluções aos objetivos estratégicos.
  • Liderar iniciativas de modernização e descentralização de dados com abordagem Data Mesh.
  • Garantir governança, segurança e compliance (LGPD, IAM, RBAC).
  • Participar ativamente do planejamento estratégico de dados, alinhando soluções às metas corporativas.
  • Apoiar a definição de roadmaps de dados e contribuir com decisões arquiteturais de longo prazo.
  • Realizar alinhamentos regulares com stakeholders técnicos e de negócio para garantir aderência às necessidades organizacionais.


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Hard Skills:

  • Experiência sólida em Azure: Data Lake Gen2, Databricks (Delta Lake), Synapse, Unity Catalog.
  • Domínio em Python e SQL para ETL/ELT em larga escala.
  • Vivência com arquitetura Data Mesh e descentralização de domínios de dados.
  • Conhecimento em governança e segurança de dados.
  • Experiência com modelagem de dados e processamento batch/streaming.
  • Desenvolver pipelines de dados com Databricks, Azure Data Factory e Synapse.
  • Aplicar práticas de DataOps e CI/CD com GitHub/Azure DevOps.


❇️ Diferencial:

  • Experiência com Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Vertex AI, Dataflow).
  • Vivência em ambientes multi-cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP).
  • Certificações em Azure ou GCP.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas como MLflow, Spark, Airflow.
  • Integrar soluções de machine learning com Vertex AI e pipelines analíticos com BigQuery.


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Soft Skills:

  • Visão estratégica e foco em valor de negócio.
  • Boa comunicação com stakeholders técnicos e executivos.
  • Proatividade e autonomia na condução de projetos.
  • Colaboração com times multidisciplinares.


✨O que oferecemos (modalidade CLT):

  • VR/VA de R$38/dia (cartão flexível);
  • Auxílio flex de R$210/mês (cartão flexível);
  • TotalPass;
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • PLR;
  • Day off de aniversário;
  • Treinamentos e certificações custeadas pela Aggrandize;
  • Programa de indicação premiada.

title: Sharepoint Team Lead
description:
Sharepoint Team Lead

**Add resumes in English**


- Responsibilities

SharePoint Development & Customization

  • Develop and customize SharePoint solutions using SPFx for modern web parts and extensions.
  • Build low-code applications and automate workflows using Power Apps and Power Automate.
  • Create custom solutions using REST API & CSOM.
  • Implement and maintain front-end solutions using JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and SPFx web parts.

SharePoint Administration & Configuration

  • Administer SharePoint On-Premise (2019, Subscription) and SharePoint Online environments.
  • Manage Central Administration, farm configurations, and service applications.
  • Handle permissions, authentication, and security management.
  • Manage site collections and content databases.
  • Customize Modern and Classic SharePoint user interfaces.

Database & Backend Development

  • Configure and maintain SQL Server for on-premise environments.
  • Manage Azure SQL and Microsoft Dataverse for cloud-based storage.

Cloud & Integration Technologies

  • Develop automation and backend services using Azure Functions.
  • Manage identity and access through Active Directory and Azure AD.
  • Integrate SharePoint with Microsoft Teams and OneDrive.
  • Perform content migration using third-party tools (e.g., ShareGate, AvePoint).
  • Implement and support Enterprise Content Management (ECM) governance solutions.


- Experience Requirements / Preferred Skills

  • Experience with Microsoft Graph API for integrating with Microsoft 365 services.
  • Experience with Power BI for data visualization and reporting.
  • Familiarity with third-party SharePoint migration tools (ShareGate, AvePoint).
  • Strong understanding of cloud technologies and hybrid SharePoint environments.
  • Good communication skills in English (Mandatory).

description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!

Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Business/Function Analysts , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract.

The IT Business/Functional Analyst plays a critical role in bridging business needs with technological solutions. The primary function is to analyze and interpret business requirements, translating them into functional specifications, and collaborate with stakeholders to ensure that technology solutions are aligned with the company's objectives. This role requires working closely with business users, developers, and project managers to deliver effective technology solutions that enhance business processes and improve efficiency.

Main Responsibilities:

  • Requirements Analysis and Specification: Conduct in-depth analysis of business requirements, translating them into detailed functional specifications for the development team. Create wireframes and mockups to visualize the proposed solutions.

  • Stakeholder Management and Leadership: Building and maintaining effective relationships with key stakeholders at all levels of the organization. Lead and coordinate project activities, ensuring that tasks are completed on time.
  • Risk Management and Budgeting: Identify and mitigate risks in technology projects. Assist in managing project budgets and ensure the use of resources in a cost-effective manner.
  • Documentation and Support: Create comprehensive user documentation and training materials. Provide ongoing technical support for implemented solutions.
  • Continuous Improvement: Analyze and resolve system problems and incidents. Participate in change management to ensure smooth transitions and user adoption.

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills):

  • Experience: Minimum of 5 to 7 years of experience as a business or functional analyst in an IT environment.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related field.
  • Languages: Advanced English and/or French.



Tools and Abilities:

  • Proficiency in business analytics tools such as Microsoft Visio, Lucidchart, Signavio .
  • Experience with project management software such as Jira, Trello, Microsoft Project, and Asana .
  • Knowledge in SQL and experience with databases such as Oracle, SQL Server and MySQL.
  • Familiarity with SDLC methodologies , including Agile, Scrum, and Waterfall .
  • Experience with ERP systems such as SAP and CRM systems such as Salesforce .

Soft Skills:

  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Problem Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Collaboration: Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and lead project activities.
  • Leadership: Proven experience in project and team management, with the ability to mentor junior team members.

Differentials (Nice to Have):

  • Education: Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration or related field.
  • Certifications: Certifications such as Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), PMP (Project Management Professional), or Certified ScrumMaster .
  • Knowledge: Experience in specific industries such as finance, healthcare, or manufacturing. Advanced programming skills in languages such as Python, Java or C# .

title: Técnico de Reparo
description:
Resumo da Posição

Faz o reparo de equipamentos eletrônicos e efetuando testes para diagnosticar defeitos e respectivas causas. Realiza o conserto substituindo componentes defeituosos.


Você será responsável por:

  • Recebe equipamentos para reparo e faz testes, utilizando jigas, osciloscópios, multímetros e diagramas elétricos, entre outros para diagnosticar defeitos e determinar causas;
  • Identifica o problema e procede o conserto reparando ou substituindo peças e componentes defeituosos e testa o módulo para garantir o perfeito funcionamento;
  • Elabora laudos técnicos a partir de análises de materiais ou módulos que apresentam defeitos críticos ou reincidentes;
  • Elabora orçamentos de materiais de clientes que não estão cobertos por contratos.


Qualificações:

  • Curso de nível médio técnico completo em Eletrônica, ou Mecatrônica e cursos afins;
  • Registro no CFT;
  • Experiência em manutenção de equipamentos em bancada, tais como micros, impressoras, no-breaks, fontes de alimentação, monitores, motherboard, etc.

title: Scrum Master SR
description:
Buscamos um(a) Scrum Master Sênior para atuar na criação de cadência para o time, promovendo entregas constantes com agilidade e foco em melhoria contínua dos processos. Você será facilitador(a) do fluxo de trabalho, parceiro(a) de PO e engenharia, e referência em cultura ágil orientada a valor e métricas.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Estabelecer e sustentar a cadência do time, facilitando rituais e garantindo fluxo de trabalho.
  • Promover entregas constantes com agilidade, orientando por métricas (lead time, throughput, WIP, CFD) e foco em valor.
  • Conduzir melhoria contínua, ajustando processos e eliminando desperdícios.
  • Antecipar e remover impedimentos/dependências, alinhando PO, times técnicos e stakeholders e fortalecendo um ambiente de alta performance.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência como Scrum Master em produtos/tecnologia.
  • Domínio de Scrum e Kanban, técnicas de facilitação, gestão de fluxo e métricas ágeis; vivência em discovery e delivery.
  • Forte habilidade de comunicação, influência sem autoridade, mediação de conflitos e coaching de times.
  • Prática com ferramentas como Jira/Confluence e Miro/Mural.


Informações adicionais:

  • Contratação CLT
  • Atuação remota

Certificada pelo 5º ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

#Vempraília

title: Contracting Manager (Activities & Experiences)
description:
Contracting Manager (supplier negotiations)

Location – Brazil

Full Time


About Us

HBX Group is the world’s leading technological partner, connecting and empowering the world of travel. We’re game-changers, disruptors, the people who bring together local and global brands in accommodation, transport, activities and payments through our network of 300,000 hotels worldwide, 60,000 hard-to-reach high-value clients such as tour operators, travel agents and loyalty schemes across 140 source markets. We are tech-driven, with a customer-first philosophy, and commercial teams whose knowledge and relationships on the ground are second to none. And of course, we have an amazing team! Our people, Team HBX Group, are the beating heart of the company who we encourage to ‘move fast, dream big and make the difference’ every day. In fact, we believe that it is tech + data + people that truly sets us apart in the market, alongside our ‘global approach, local touch’ mentality.


Job Summary:

As the face of HBX Group to our suppliers, you will develop strong relationships with our suppliers for a defined portfolio of activities within a specific geographic area.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead the contracting process with our clients in a B2B and B2C environment, focused on signing the most competitive rates for HBX Group.
  • Negotiate contract renewal conditions such as: rate, inventory, offers, release periods, marketing contributions, overrides, cancellation policy.
  • Monitor the performance of each hotel working closely with the Yield Manager to ensure competitiveness and availability is not an issue.
  • Act as the face-to-face key point contact for experienced suppliers and develop and maintain excellent relationships with them.
  • Support the resolution of major supplier or client complaints, negotiating the most suitable solution to maintain good service and a positive relationship with them.
  • Ensure the supplier has a clear understanding of HBX Group value proposition and marketing tools to optimize the income of each contract.


Skillset and Experience Required:

  • Strong negotiation and relationship management skills.
  • Experience in contracting and supplier management within the travel or activities industry.
  • Excellent communication and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to analyze performance metrics and implement improvement strategies.
  • Proficiency in relevant software tools and systems.
  • Languages: Fluent in Portuguese, Spanish additional languages are a plus.


At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good.

We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference.


You will have the opportunity to work for a company that is going through significant change in becoming the world´s leading travel services provider. We are looking for people that are ready to ride the wave in this exciting journey.

title: Cyber Security Manager (Blockchain & Tokenization)
description:
Security Manager

Location: Americas, Remote


About Us

Pointsville is an end-to-end alternative asset factory, offering solutions that bridge the gap between emerging digital financial technologies and traditional asset classes. We specialize in Alternative Asset Digitalization and Loyalty Innovation, empowering organizations to unlock new value through tokenization, stablecoin infrastructure, and real-world asset integration.


Our globally distributed team of innovators, builders, and thinkers is passionate about the future of finance. Join Pointsville and be part of shaping the future of digital finance!


Overview

We’re looking for a hands-on security leader who can build, manage, and scale Pointsville’s security and compliance programs. This role is ideal for someone capable of designing enterprise-grade security programs, engineering security tools, and embedding best practices into fast-moving development environments.


What You’ll Do

Security Strategy, Leadership & Program Development

  • Build and lead Pointsville’s global security and compliance function from the ground up.
  • Develop and implement the company-wide security strategy, policies, and frameworks aligned with business and regulatory goals.
  • Conduct organization-wide risk assessments, vulnerability scans, and incident response exercises.
  • Drive security awareness and training programs to strengthen company-wide accountability.
  • Collaborate with executive leadership to ensure security goals align with organizational priorities.


Technical Security Engineering

  • Lead the design and development of advanced security testing and monitoring platforms, including distributed fuzzing systems and validation frameworks.
  • Conduct secure architecture reviews and threat modeling for infrastructure, APIs, smart contracts, and cloud-native services.
  • Integrate Secure SDLC practices into CI/CD pipelines — automating vulnerability discovery, testing, and compliance reporting.
  • Perform deep-dive analysis of vulnerabilities, exploits, and mitigations across web, mobile, and blockchain systems.
  • Partner with Engineering and DevOps to ensure secure-by-design implementation in infrastructure-as-code and deployments.


Cloud, Infrastructure & Data Protection

  • Oversee cloud security architecture (AWS preferred), including network segmentation, IAM, and continuous monitoring.
  • Manage VPNs, multi-region access, and secret management tools (Vault, KMS, etc.).
  • Ensure data privacy and protection measures are embedded in all systems and products.
  • Lead investigations, containment, and response in the event of security incidents or data breaches.


Compliance, Risk & Governance

  • Develop and maintain security compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, GDPR, and CCPA.
  • Prepare and manage internal and external audits and certifications.
  • Identify, document, and mitigate enterprise security and compliance risks.
  • Establish a “privacy by design” and “security by default” culture in collaboration with legal and product teams.


Communication & Collaboration

  • Serve as the main point of contact for all internal and external security and compliance matters.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Operations to align security controls with business needs.
  • Deliver clear reporting and recommendations to leadership on security posture, incidents, and ongoing improvements.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in security engineering, product security, or infrastructure security roles.
  • Proven track record designing and deploying security tools and frameworks at scale.
  • Deep understanding of cryptography, secure protocols, and key management systems.
  • Expertise in AWS, Docker/Kubernetes, and large-scale distributed systems.
  • Strong knowledge of application security (OWASP, STRIDE, TARA) and vulnerability mitigation.
  • Proficiency in one or more system languages (Java, C, C++, Rust, Go) and one scripting language (Python, Shell).
  • Experience with blockchain and smart contract security preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to automate security controls, conduct penetration testing, and perform design reviews.
  • Strong communication and leadership skills, with experience mentoring engineers and influencing cross-functional teams.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in written and spoken English


We are committed to providing equal opportunity for qualified applicants to contract positions, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. This is a contract opportunity, not a direct employment role.

title: Profissional Back End – .NET Pleno
description:
Código da vaga: 55483


Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei #fera em desenvolvimento, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos por #feras com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • Experiência sólida com .NET em suas versões antigas e atuais.
  • Experiência com AWS e suas principais ferramentas.
  • Experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços e tecnologias de mensageria como RabbitMQ.
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais, como SQL Server e MySQL, e NoSQL como MongoDB e outros.
  • Experiência em processos de Integração Contínua e Entrega Contínua (CI/CD).
  • Conhecimento em versionamento de código utilizando Git.


- Diferenciais:

  • Certificações AWS.
  • Experiência com outras plataformas de cloud, como Azure ou GCP.
  • Conhecimento em containers, como Docker e Kubernetes.
  • Vivência com sistemas de alta disponibilidade e escalabilidade.


- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei #fera em desenvolvimento, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos por #feras com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • Experiência sólida com .NET em suas versões antigas e atuais.
  • Experiência com AWS e suas principais ferramentas.
  • Experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços e tecnologias de mensageria como RabbitMQ.
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais, como SQL Server e MySQL, e NoSQL como MongoDB e outros.
  • Experiência em processos de Integração Contínua e Entrega Contínua (CI/CD).
  • Conhecimento em versionamento de código utilizando Git.


- Diferenciais:

  • Certificações AWS.
  • Experiência com outras plataformas de cloud, como Azure ou GCP.
  • Conhecimento em containers, como Docker e Kubernetes.
  • Vivência com sistemas de alta disponibilidade e escalabilidade.


- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Data Warehouse Architect
description:
Databricks Data Warehouse ArchitectAbout the role:

One of the largest companies in the world in the Gaming industry is seeking a hands-on Data Architect with DataWarehouse Engineer expertise in Databricks (DBX) and AWS-native data services to spearhead the design and implementation of a new data warehouse instance for a major product line. This role will involve building from the ground up—architecting scalable pipelines, optimizing lakehouse performance, and integrating seamlessly with diverse real-time and batch data sources across AWS.

The ideal candidate is passionate about data architecture , thrives in fast-moving environments, and has a proven track record of setting up high-performance lakehouse platforms on Databricks with a strong foundation in data warehousing principles .

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and deploy a new Databricks Lakehouse instance tailored to the client’s product-level data needs.
  • Architect and implement robust data ingestion pipelines using Spark (PySpark/Scala) and Delta Lake.
  • Integrate AWS-native services (S3, Glue, Athena, Redshift, Lambda) with Databricks for optimized performance and scalability.
  • Define data models, optimize query performance, and establish warehouse governance best practices.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product teams, data scientists, and DevOps to streamline data workflows.
  • Maintain CI/CD, preferably DBX for data pipelines using GitOps and Infrastructure-as-Code.
  • Monitor data jobs and resolve performance bottlenecks or failures across environments.
Required Skills & Experience: Databricks / Lakehouse Architecture
  • End-to-end setup of Databricks workspaces and Unity Catalog
  • Expertise in Delta Lake internals , file compaction, and schema enforcement
  • Advanced PySpark/SQL skills for ETL and transformations
AWS Native Integration
  • Deep experience with AWS Glue , S3 , Redshift Spectrum , Lambda , and Athena
  • IAM and VPC configuration knowledge for secure cloud integrations
Data Warehousing & Modeling
  • Strong grasp of modern dimensional modeling (star/snowflake schemas)
  • Experience setting up lakehouse design patterns for mixed workloads
Automation & DevOps
  • Familiarity with CI/CD for data engineering using tools like DBX, Terraform, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps
  • Proficient in monitoring tools like CloudWatch, Datadog, or New Relic for data pipelines
Bonus/Nice to Have:
  • Experience supporting gaming or real-time analytics workloads
  • Familiarity with Airflow , Kafka , or EventBridge
  • Exposure to data privacy and compliance practices (GDPR, CCPA)
Other Details:
  • Location : Latin America (LATAM) region - Remote, USA - Remote
  • Length : 1+ Year

Client : Gaming giant

title: Partner Enablement Consultant
description:
About Zensar Technologies

Zensar is a leading digital solutions and technology services company partnering with global organizations on their digital transformation journey. A technology partner of choice, with strong track-record of innovation, credible investment in digital solutions and assertion of commitment to client’s success, Zensar’s comprehensive range of services and solutions enable clients achieve new thresholds of performance. Part of the $40 billion APAX Partners’ portfolio of companies, Zensar is uniquely positioned to help existing businesses run efficiently, manage legacy transformation and plan business growth through innovative digital platform.

Working at Zensar

Working at Zensar is an enriching experience. While work is driven by innovation and passion, fun is taken seriously too. An open environment is encouraged making it easy to brainstorm with colleagues. Creative thinking is encouraged through time out activities. Moreover, the offices have been designed to foster creativity and communication, bringing a little bit of home into work every day. Zensar provides and a comprehensive benefit package for all fulltime employees.


Indigo Slate@ Zensar Company is seeking a Partner Enablement Consultant in Brazil (Remote). This is open for Full time remote with outstanding growth opportunities. All candidates must be bilingual: Native Portuguese and Advance English verbal and written.


Job Description

Consultants are responsible for advising, guiding, scoping, developing strategic learning plans that align to channel partner business teams and their outcomes, with a strong ability to get buy-ins from senior business stakeholders. Consultants act as SMEs for client learning programs (such as certification, products, offerings, tools, processes, training, and exams) and work with technology, L&D and business teams to drive partner workforce capacity and capability by aligning to measurable business outcomes.

Self-driven, analytical, and strategic thinkers—who also have excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to develop and execute plans—will succeed in this consultative role.

T

his is not a role in instructional design, curriculum/content development or training delivery or

operations.


High-level skills and experience

• Strong consultative mindset and consulting skill set with a strong point-of-view on solutions and

recommendations.

• Strategic, ‘big picture’ thinking and connecting the dots.

• Ability to understand the ‘why’ along with the ‘what’ and ‘how’ of a partner need (i.e., well- rounded learning plans that drive business outcomes rather than just chasing headcount/numbers)

• Strong commercial awareness/business acumen of the client’s and channel partner’s business.

• Ability to align learning with client and partner ROI and business drivers.

• Thought leadership with new ideas, strategies, framework, processes to drive results.

• Executive presence and comfortable with public speaking (in-person and virtual) with senior

stakeholders and large audiences

• Data analytics (ability to dig into trends and forecast) and data story telling.

• Technical prowess to understand data/AI/cloud/technical knowledge.

• Highly collaborative across various business functions/senior stakeholder management.

• Proactive and independent, ability to excel in a fast-paced environment while working from vision through execution.


Expected tasks and responsibilities

• Execute frameworks to assess capability and capacity workforce skill gaps in partner organizations.

• Conduct partner needs analysis (discovery and scoping at business, technical and learning levels)

• Enabling consulting conversations with business leaders in partner teams to understand their

business drivers.

• Propose strategic learning plans to all internal and external stakeholders.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


We are seeking a Full-Stack Data Engineer to join our Mobile Applications department. This is a hybrid role that combines data engineering with data science overlap, giving you full ownership of the data lifecycle — from ingestion to transformation, analysis, and storytelling.

You will build and optimize scalable pipelines, ingest mobile app data from diverse sources, ensure infrastructure reliability, and deliver insights that directly influence how our apps grow. The ideal candidate thrives at the intersection of engineering and analytics, equally capable of writing production-grade pipelines and uncovering meaningful trends in user behavior.


Key Responsibilities


Data Infrastructure & Pipelines

  • Build and maintain scalable, end-to-end pipelines across cloud environments. Ingest and transform data from files, APIs, mobile telemetry (Firebase, Amplitude, Google Analytics), and external databases into centralized stores.
  • Continuously monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize infrastructure for performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Implement data quality monitoring, governance policies, and best practices for privacy, security, and compliance.
  • Participate in technical architecture discussions, contributing expertise on scalable, efficient data systems.


Analytics & Insights

  • Conduct exploratory and advanced analysis using SQL, Python, and statistical methods.
  • Collaborate with Analysts, Data Scientists, and Product Managers to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Support experimentation and A/B testing by ensuring clean, reliable datasets and analyzing results.
  • Deliver actionable recommendations that influence mobile product strategy, user acquisition, and retention.


Collaboration & Best Practices

  • Engage in peer code reviews to uphold high standards of quality and maintainability.
  • Work cross-functionally with software engineering and business teams to ensure data solutions align with company priorities.
  • Document pipelines, workflows, and methodologies to foster reusability and knowledge sharing.


Who You Are


  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar technical role focused on data infrastructure and pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL and proficiency in Python (or a similar programming language such as Java or C#).
  • Experience with AWS (Redshift, RDS, S3) and Google Cloud (BigQuery, Firebase) for managing cloud-based databases and analytics tools.
  • Familiarity with data pipeline orchestration tools (dbt, Airflow, or similar).
  • Strong knowledge of data warehousing concepts, ELT/ETL best practices, and dimensional modeling. Experience with version control systems (e.g., GitHub).
  • Excellent communicator who can bridge technical depth with clear storytelling for non-technical stakeholders.

You will build and optimize scalable pipelines, ingest mobile app data from diverse sources, ensure infrastructure reliability, and deliver insights that directly influence how our apps grow. The ideal candidate thrives at the intersection of engineering and analytics, equally capable of writing production-grade pipelines and uncovering meaningful trends in user behavior.


Key Responsibilities


Data Infrastructure & Pipelines

  • Build and maintain scalable, end-to-end pipelines across cloud environments. Ingest and transform data from files, APIs, mobile telemetry (Firebase, Amplitude, Google Analytics), and external databases into centralized stores.
  • Continuously monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize infrastructure for performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Implement data quality monitoring, governance policies, and best practices for privacy, security, and compliance.
  • Participate in technical architecture discussions, contributing expertise on scalable, efficient data systems.


Analytics & Insights

  • Conduct exploratory and advanced analysis using SQL, Python, and statistical methods.
  • Collaborate with Analysts, Data Scientists, and Product Managers to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Support experimentation and A/B testing by ensuring clean, reliable datasets and analyzing results.
  • Deliver actionable recommendations that influence mobile product strategy, user acquisition, and retention.


Collaboration & Best Practices

  • Engage in peer code reviews to uphold high standards of quality and maintainability.
  • Work cross-functionally with software engineering and business teams to ensure data solutions align with company priorities.
  • Document pipelines, workflows, and methodologies to foster reusability and knowledge sharing.


Who You Are


  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar technical role focused on data infrastructure and pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL and proficiency in Python (or a similar programming language such as Java or C#).
  • Experience with AWS (Redshift, RDS, S3) and Google Cloud (BigQuery, Firebase) for managing cloud-based databases and analytics tools.
  • Familiarity with data pipeline orchestration tools (dbt, Airflow, or similar).
  • Strong knowledge of data warehousing concepts, ELT/ETL best practices, and dimensional modeling. Experience with version control systems (e.g., GitHub).
  • Excellent communicator who can bridge technical depth with clear storytelling for non-technical stakeholders.
