title: VMware Administrator
description:
VMware Engineer (Remote – EST Hours)

Schedule: 40h/week • On-call rotation required

Contract: Contractor


About the Role

Our client is looking for an experienced VMware Engineer to join our infrastructure team, supporting large-scale virtualized environments and ensuring performance, reliability, and scalability across global data centers.

The ideal professional has strong hands-on experience with vSAN , VMware cluster management, upgrades, and networking at the hypervisor level.


Key Responsibilities

Virtualization & Infrastructure Management

  • Administer and support VMware ESXi and vCenter environments (versions 7 and 8; migration to 9 planned).
  • Manage VMware clusters, VMware Distributed Switches (VDS), and ESXi host configurations.
  • Perform vCenter and ESXi upgrades, patching, and lifecycle management.
  • Ensure optimal configuration, performance, and availability of virtual infrastructure.

vSAN (Mandatory)

  • Manage and support VMware vSAN environments (minimum 2 years of hands-on experience).
  • Monitor vSAN health, performance, and storage capacity.
  • Troubleshoot vSAN-related storage, performance, and node issues.

Networking & System Administration

  • Configure and troubleshoot VLANs, trunks, port groups, and VM networking issues.
  • Understand network configuration at the hypervisor level and how to troubleshoot VM connectivity.
  • Integrate and manage Active Directory within vCenter environments.


Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong experience with VMware vSAN (must-have).
  • 5+ years of experience administering VMware environments (versions 7 and 8).
  • Hands-on expertise in:
  • VMware Cluster & VDS Management
  • vSAN configuration and maintenance
  • ESXi host upgrades and patching
  • vCenter lifecycle management
  • Understanding of VLANs, trunks, and virtual networking.
  • Basic knowledge of Active Directory integration in vCenter.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills in complex virtualized environments.


Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting large enterprise VMware environments.
  • Familiarity with automation or scripting tools (PowerCLI, Python).
  • Knowledge of backup/restore strategies in virtual infrastructures.


Work Environment

  • Remote role aligned to EST business hours (8:30 AM–5:30 PM) .
  • Includes on-call rotation for critical support needs.

title: Consultor de Investimentos WS - Parceiros XP | Minas Gerais
description:
Essa oportunidade é para consultor de investimento nas consultorias Wealth Service parceiras da rede XP, que tem a missão de ajudar o brasileiro a investir melhor. São times apaixonados por relacionamento com cliente, aprofundamento técnico sobre alocação de recursos e prospecção de novos negócios.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Prospecção de novos clientes;
  • Atuação na consultoria de investimentos, sendo responsável por orientar o cliente final na gestão de patrimônio;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas e elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos, identificando oportunidades e apresentando de forma objetiva;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico e acontecimentos relevantes.


Informações Importantes

  • Trabalho remoto em diversas praças do país


Pré-Requisito

  • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;
  • Alto nível de intensidade e disciplina;
  • Conhecimento sobre cenário econômico atual;
  • Experiência prévia em instituições financeiras;
  • Certificação CEA, CPF, CFA e/ou CGA (aceitável com prova agendada)


Você pode ter destaque se:

  • Possuir carteira de clientes para prospecção;
  • Ter base de clientes já estabelecida é um grande diferencial;
  • Conhecimentos sobre produtos financeiros;
  • Noções básicas de macroeconomia e atualidades.

title: Registration Assistant
description:
Mission of the Role:

Due to growth & expansion of business in Brazil, CAC is looking to hire a seasoned professional who will be responsible for support and accelerate product registration and compliance activities in the Brazilian market , reporting to Registration manager in Brazil. The key objectives for this role are:

  • Managing the submission, follow-up, and maintenance of product registrations in Brazil
  • ensures compliance with national regulatory requirements (MAPA, IBAMA, ANVISA) and supports the company’s product launch plans in alignment with global and regional regulatory strategies.


Key Accountabilities:

  • Develop and execute registration strategies for Brazil in line with business priorities and product portfolio
  • Prepare, compile, and submit registration dossiers for technical and formulated products in compliance with local regulatory requirements
  • Coordinate with external consultants, laboratories, manufacturers, and internal technical teams to ensure high-quality and complete submissions.
  • Communicate with regulatory authorities (MAPA, IBAMA, ANVISA) through local partners or directly when required.
  • Monitor progress of submissions, follow up on authority requests, and manage timelines to ensure efficient approval.
  • Track and analyze updates in Brazilian and LATAM regulatory frameworks, assessing potential business impacts and advising management accordingly.
  • Maintain accurate registration data and documentation archives to ensure full traceability and compliance.
  • Provide regulatory support to commercial, marketing, and R&D teams regarding registration timelines, status, and compliance requirements.
  • Support post-registration activities, such as renewals, label updates, and re-registration processes.
  • Collaborate with global regulatory teams to align strategies and share best practices.



Technical Knowledge and Skills:

  • Graduate in Agricultural Science, Chemistry, Toxicology, Environmental Science, or related fields.
  • 4 years of working experience in regulatory affairs or product registration within the agrochemical / crop protection industry.
  • In-depth understanding of Brazil’s registration procedures and authorities: MAPA/IBMA/ANVISA and state authorities.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple registration projects with strict timelines
  • Strong coordination and communication skills with internal cross-functional teams and external stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in English (written & spoken) and Portuguese (mandatory for Brazil-based communication).
  • Detail-oriented and capable of interpreting technical and scientific data.


Nice-to-Have:

  • Previous experience in a multinational agrochemical company or regulatory consulting firm


Soft skill:

  • Demonstrates a proactive, self-driven approach with a high sense of accountability.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, cross-cultural environment

title: Principal AI Engineer - AI in Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE


We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.


In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.


Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.


Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements


Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.


WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU


This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.


You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!


1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions


2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy


3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards


4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

title: Analista de Finanças Sênior
description:
Oportunidade para atuar em uma empresa renomada no setor de saúde, referenciada por sua atuação e excelência no mercado.


Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:


O analista sênior terá como principal missão garantir que os processos de recebimento fiscal estejam corretamente alinhados as práticas e políticas internas, garantindo que os documentos fiscais estejam em conformidade com as exigências legais e sejam corretamente escriturados; resolvendo inconsistências entre documentos fiscais e lançamentos contábeis. Sempre buscando identificar oportunidades de automação e melhorias no processo, participando de projetos da área de R2P.



Principais atividades:


  • Interagir com áreas internas para resolver pendências fiscais;
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas;
  • Estar atualizado com mudanças na legislação tributária;
  • Apoiar em treinamentos e capacitação de equipe;
  • Participação em projetos e fóruns relacionados a temas da área;
  • Criação e acompanhamento de indicadores e relatórios da área;
  • Apoio a gestão da área.


Buscamos alguém que apresente:


  • Ensino superior completo (Administração, Contabilidade, Economia ou áreas relacionadas);
  • Conhecimento em Excel (intermediário a avançado);
  • Conhecimento avançado em SAP – módulo MM e FI, transações de Recebimento Fiscal;
  • Conhecimento dos processos e rotinas de Recebimento Fiscal;
  • Será um diferencial conhecimento das rotinas de Contas a Pagar e em demais atividades do módulo de MM (SAP).


Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos.


Informações da vaga:


Modelo de Trabalho: Home Office.

Horário de Trabalho: 08:00h as 17:48h segunda a sexta-feira.


O que oferecemos:


Assistência Médica e Odontológica;

Vale-Alimentação e Vale-Refeição;

Vale-Transporte;

Auxílio-Creche;

Seguro de Vida;

Wellhub;

Participação nos Lucros;

Previdência Privada.

description:

100% Home Office.

Pessoa Jurídica (MEI).

Dedicação exclusiva em 8 horas diárias de trabalho.

Remuneração fixa iniciando em R$1.500,00 podendo ir até R$2.000,00 + variável em % sobre as vendas.


Formulário de Aplicação:


DESCRIÇÃO DA OPORTUNIDADE


Nossa agência está buscando um prestador(a) de serviços Closer de Vendas, para integrar nossa equipe e atuar como ponto focal entre a agência e nossos clientes. Buscamos um profissional com excelente habilidade de comunicação, capacidade de resolver problemas e comprometimento em oferecer a melhor experiência para os clientes.


DAS RESPONSABILIDADES


Responsável por confirmar reunião com potencial cliente alguns minutos antes

Responsável por follow-up com potenciais clientes pós reunião

Responsável por realizar as call de vendas para vender o serviço da empresa (Gestão de Tráfego) 

Responsável por conduzir o lead ao fechamento do serviço 

Responsável por redigir o contrato, enviar ao cliente e colher assinatura 


DOS REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES


Experiência ou curso/formação na área de Vendas.

Cursos de atendimento ao cliente ou curso superior na área de Marketing ou administração será considerado um diferencial.

Excelentes habilidades de comunicação escrita e verbal em português.

Habilidade para resolver problemas e lidar com situações adversas.

Domínio de ferramentas de CRM, gestão de projetos e pacote Office.

Comprometimento com a excelência no atendimento e satisfação do cliente.

Espírito de equipe e habilidade para trabalhar em um ambiente colaborativo.

Nossa agência está buscando um prestador(a) de serviços Closer de Vendas, para integrar nossa equipe e atuar como ponto focal entre a agência e nossos clientes. Buscamos um profissional com excelente habilidade de comunicação, capacidade de resolver problemas e comprometimento em oferecer a melhor experiência para os clientes.

Experiência ou curso/formação na área de Vendas.

Excelentes habilidades de comunicação escrita e verbal em português.

Habilidade para resolver problemas e lidar com situações adversas.

Domínio de ferramentas de CRM, gestão de projetos e pacote Office.

Comprometimento com a excelência no atendimento e satisfação do cliente.

Espírito de equipe e habilidade para trabalhar em um ambiente colaborativo.

title: Squad Leader/Scrum Master
description:
Vaga: Scrum Master / Agile Lead


Sobre o Projeto:

O(a) profissional atuará em um projeto de modernização de sistema legado , com foco em coordenar times ágeis durante a migração e reengenharia de sistemas.

A posição exige liderança, organização e visão estratégica para garantir entregas consistentes e alinhadas aos objetivos técnicos e de negócio.


Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar squads multidisciplinares durante as fases de modernização e migração do sistema legado.
  • Facilitar cerimônias ágeis (daily, planning, review e retrospectiva), promovendo engajamento e colaboração entre os times.
  • Monitorar métricas de produtividade, qualidade e entrega , garantindo a transparência e previsibilidade do projeto.
  • Apoiar o Product Owner na gestão do backlog, priorização e remoção de impedimentos.
  • Garantir alinhamento técnico entre as equipes e os Tech Leads/Arquitetos , assegurando coerência entre planejamento e execução.
  • Atuar como agente de melhoria contínua , promovendo boas práticas de agilidade e cultura colaborativa.


Requisitos Técnicos e Experiências:

  • Experiência comprovada como Scrum Master, Agile Coach ou Líder Técnico em ambientes ágeis.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão ágil , como Jira, Confluence e similares.
  • Habilidade em liderança, facilitação e resolução de conflitos .
  • Vivência com projetos de modernização ou reengenharia de sistemas , preferencialmente com uso de Strangler Pattern .
  • Desejável experiência como Gerente de Projetos , com conhecimento em metodologias tradicionais (PMBOK) .


Desejável:

  • Certificações em Scrum Master (PSM, CSM) ou Gerenciamento de Projetos (PMP, PMI-ACP) .
  • Experiência em ambientes híbridos , que combinem práticas ágeis e tradicionais.
  • Capacidade de conduzir transições culturais e técnicas em equipes de diferentes níveis de maturidade ágil.

title: Desenvolvedor Salesforce - Sênior (Home Office)
description:
Resumo da oportunidade:

Você fará parte de um time que cria e evolui soluções no ecossistema Salesforce, com foco em Service Cloud. O papel envolve desenvolvimento com alta qualidade e performance, integrações e desenho de dados, colaborando com equipes de projeto e interagindo com suporte global em inglês.


Responsabilidades do dia a dia:

  • Implementar funcionalidades no Salesforce (Apex, Lightning Web Components, Visualforce/Aura) com foco em performance e qualidade.
  • Desenvolver e manter integrações com APIs (REST, SOAP, Metadata) e orquestrar processos com Flow.
  • Modelar dados e desenhar soluções aderentes ao Service Cloud.
  • Participar ativamente das definições técnicas com as equipes de projeto, propondo melhorias.
  • Versionar código com Git e colaborar em práticas ágeis do time.
  • Acompanhar novidades do Salesforce e aplicar quando fizer sentido.
  • Atuar em esquema de plantão fora do horário comercial, em rodízio com o time.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de implementação e customização no Salesforce Service Cloud.
  • Stack: Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Components, LWC, Aura, batches, triggers e schedules.
  • Integrações: experiência com Salesforce APIs (REST, SOAP, Metadata).
  • Arquitetura/Dados: modelagem de dados e design de soluções Salesforce.
  • Processos: práticas ágeis e versionamento com Git.
  • Automação: Flow.
  • Canais/IA: Digital Engagement e Einstein Bots e AgentForce.
  • Idioma: inglês para conversação (comunicação com Suporte Global Salesforce).
  • Disponibilidade: plantão fora do horário comercial, em esquema de rodízio com o time.


Habilidades:

  • Escrever código Apex e LWC performáticos, seguros e reutilizáveis.
  • Projetar integrações resilientes e monitoráveis entre sistemas.
  • Estruturar modelos de dados consistentes e aderentes ao negócio.
  • Colaborar em definições técnicas e revisão de soluções com o time.
  • Organizar o trabalho em ciclos ágeis, mantendo rastreabilidade no Git.


Atitudes:

  • Comunicação clara e colaboração no trabalho em equipe.
  • Resolução de problemas com foco em impacto e qualidade.
  • Adaptabilidade a mudanças de contexto e prioridades.
  • Aprendizado contínuo e curiosidade pelas novidades da plataforma.


Condições da vaga

  • Modelo de contratação: PJ .
  • Modelo de trabalho: Remoto (Home Office) .

title: ANALISTA PREVENÇÃO RISCOS E FRAUDES PL
description:
Resumo da Vaga:

O Analista de Prevenção a Riscos e Fraudes Pleno será responsável por investigar denúncias e suspeitas de fraudes no Grupo Petrópolis, recebidas pelo Canal de Conduta e outros meios oficiais. O profissional atuará de maneira imparcial, ética e legal, visando identificar e esclarecer fatos, fraudes de colaboradores e terceiros. O foco é fornecer informações cruciais para a tomada de decisões dentro dos parâmetros legais, normas e procedimentos internos, além de apoiar o jurídico nas análises dos casos.



OBJETIVOS:

Avaliação de Denúncias e Demandas:

  • Analisar e avaliar denúncias de fraudes oriundas do Canal de Conduta e outros meios oficiais, identificando os procedimentos a serem adotados e contribuindo com informações para decisões internas.

Investigações Sistêmicas:

  • Realizar investigações utilizando sistemas internos, envolvendo públicos internos e externos, para detectar violações legais, políticas e procedimentos. Identificar oportunidades de ações corretivas nos processos da empresa contribuindo para melhoria contínua.

Investigações em Campo:

  • Conduzir investigações, com diligências e contato com testemunhas e envolvidos, coletando evidências (vídeos, fotos, depoimentos, relatórios) para subsidiar a investigação.

Elaboração de Relatórios:

  • Preparar relatórios detalhados com os resultados das investigações, identificando falhas ou não conformidades e informando as áreas pertinentes, como o departamento jurídico.
  • Atualização Constante:

Manter-se atualizado quanto às normas e procedimentos internos relativos às investigações e prevenção a fraudes.

  • Apoio à Gestão:

Auxiliar na criação de materiais e apresentações para reporte à gestão, além de apoiar na elaboração e revisão de diretrizes e procedimentos do departamento.



DIFERENCIAIS:

  • Experiência em Segurança Pública: Profissionais com histórico em segurança pública, como policiais, bombeiros ou agentes de segurança;
  • Cursos relacionados a investigação e prevenção de fraudes, técnicas de entrevista, conhecimento em Compliance e Canal de conduta;
  • Experiência nas Forças Armadas: Profissionais com experiência militar, incluindo ex-militares e reservistas.



REQUISITOS:

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Administração de Empresas, Gestão em Segurança Empresarial, Investigações de fraudes, Compliance e áreas correlacionadas;
  • Conhecimentos básicos das atividades de Compliance;
  • Gestão de Riscos e Investigações;
  • Análise de Dados;
  • Conhecimento no sistema SAP;
  • Excel Intermediário/ Avançado e BI;
  • Experiência na área de prevenção à fraude;
  • Conhecimento de coleta de dados e informações de fontes públicas (OSINT);
  • Habilitação categoria B ativa;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.


BENEFÍCIOS

  • Assistência médica e odontológica estendida a dependentes;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale alimentação;
  • Vale refeição;
  • Auxílio material escolar (filhos);
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Wellhub;
  • Participação nos lucros;
  • Descontos em produtos;
  • Programas de saúde e bem-estar;
  • Carro da empresa como ferramenta de trabalho.

title: Cientista de Dados Sênior
description:
Se você é apaixonado por dados e desafios analíticos, essa vaga é para você!

Profissional com sólida experiência em Visão Computacional , Machine Learning e análise estatística , atuando em todas as etapas do ciclo de dados — da coleta e transformação à modelagem e diagnóstico de performance . Domínio em Python (Pandas, Scikit-Learn, OpenCV) , SQL e Cloud AWS , com forte foco em extrair padrões ocultos, gerar insights valiosos e impulsionar decisões baseadas em dados.


Informações:

Modelo de trabalho via contrato PJ;

Home Office;


Requisitos:

  • Conhecimentos em Cloud Azure, AWS e Databricks.
  • (Foco em AWS) Conhecimentos do processo de construção de modelos.
  • Análise Descritiva e Exploratória de Dados.
  • Teste de Hipóteses Inferência Clássica e Bayesiana.
  • Construção de modelos Estatísticos de Machine Learning.
  • Análise de Diagnósticos.
  • Fortes Conhecimentos de Python/R.
  • Experiência com análise de dados para descobrir padrões ocultos.
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de visualização de dados.
  • Experiência com análise e resolução de problemas relacionados a dados.
  • Experiência com programação em Python e seu ecossistema de análise de dados (Pandas, Scikit-Learn , Numpy, Pillow e OpenCV).
  • Experiência com extração e análise de banco de dados (SQL).
  • Experiência com limpeza e transformação de dados (Feature Engineering).
  • Experiência com Algoritmos de Regressão, Classificação e Clustering.
  • Experiência com Reinforcement Learning e Association Rules Learning.


Será um Diferencial...

  • Inglês avançado.
  • Mestrado ou Doutorado em Ciência da Computação, Matemática, Estatística, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência com os ambientes Airflow, Git, Cloud Azure, Pentaho Data Integration.
  • Experiência com MS Fabric, Copilot Studio, Data Factory, Databricks, PowerBI, Kafka, Spark, Spark Streaming.
  • Experiência com ML , DL, AutoML, MLOps e Engenharia de Dados


Atividades:

  • Foco no desenvolvimento de soluções dentro do Lab de Inovação do Cliente.
  • Realizar análises descritivas e exploratórias para entendimento de dados e levantamento de hipóteses técnicas.
  • Desenvolver modelagem preditiva utilizando o estado da arte em Machine Learning e as métricas adequadas para seleção de modelos Validar tecnicamente a utilização dos modelos preditivos.
  • Desenvolver certificação prática do desempenho dos modelos (teste A/B, controle/intervenção, planejamento e experimentos).
  • Colaborar com o time de Estatísticos, Engenheiros em Machine Learning, Economistas para resolver problemas usando Data Science.
  • Validação de estruturas de dados e Feature Engineering.
  • Trabalhar com o time de Engenheiros de Dados e Arquitetos de Dados na criação de Datasets para treinamento de múltiplos modelos.
  • Coletar, limpar, armazenar, organizar, integrar dados e ajudar na criação de pipelines de dados. Auxiliar na expansão do uso da ciência de dados nas frentes dos negócios.

title: Electrical BIM Modeler
description:
Now Hiring: Electrical BIM Modeler

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Engagement Type: Full-Time

Work Format: Work From Home


Note: Interested candidates are invited to submit their resume in English.


At Eracore , we bring innovation and precision to the forefront of electrical construction through advanced BIM modeling. From coordination and prefabrication to detailed shop drawings, we support some of the most complex and high-stakes electrical projects in the United States including Data Centers, Government Facilities, Manufacturing Plants, and cutting-edge Commercial developments.


Backed by a dynamic team of 40+ talented modelers and engineers, Eracore is more than just a workplace its a launchpad for ambitious professionals. We collaborate with top-tier electrical contractors nationwide, offering unparalleled exposure, hands-on experience, and real opportunities for career advancement.


If you're ready to work on game-changing projects, grow alongside a fast-rising company, and be part of shaping the future of electrical construction, Eracore is where your next chapter begins.


Join us and shape the future of the construction industry!


Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a BIM/VDC Specialist at Eracore . The Electrical BIM Modeler will be responsible for creating 3D models and shop drawings to provide clarity and precision during field installations. The role involves utilizing BIM software for visualization and validation of electrical installations.


Qualifications

  • 4-7 Years of Experience with Revit
  • Building Information Modeling (BIM) and Construction Drawings skills
  • Experience with Prefabrication Spool Drawings
  • Experience in working with Mechanical Electrical and Plumbing (MEP) systems
  • Proficiency in Architecture and Modeler software
  • Knowledge of electrical design principles and calculations
  • Ability to interpret and create single line diagrams
  • Experience in load calculations and voltage drop evaluations
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills
  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related field

title: Desenvolvedor de front-end - Shopify
description:
Buscamos um desenvolvedor Shopify. A posição é remota e o fuso horário deve estar alinhado com o de Pittsburgh (EUA) .


Responsabilidades:

1. Reescrita do Storefront em Hydrogen

  • Reconstruir e aprimorar a vitrine Shopify existente da Industrial Powder usando Hydrogen 2.0 e a Shopify Storefront GraphQL API .
  • Replicar e melhorar o conjunto de recursos atual:
  • Páginas de detalhes de produtos
  • Diferenciação entre produtos sob encomenda, em estoque, painéis, tambores e pequenos lotes
  • Coleções com filtragem
  • Lógica de preços específica para B2B
  • Descontos, comportamento do carrinho e integração de checkout
  • Gerenciamento de contas de clientes
  • Pesquisa, navegação e acessibilidade
  • Layout responsivo com foco em dispositivos móveis


2. Biblioteca de Componentes Reutilizáveis

  • Criar uma biblioteca de componentes de interface (UI) baseada em React , seguindo o sistema de design PPG Primer :
  • Reconstruir componentes principais (botões, cabeçalhos, banners, modais, tabelas etc.) para React, usando os tokens de design existentes (atualmente uma biblioteca de componentes em .NET)
  • Garantir acessibilidade, responsividade e personalização
  • Fornecer documentação e exemplos ao vivo usando o Storybook
  • Entregar como um submódulo Git ou pacote privado NPM


3. Framework de Configuração de Lançamento Rápido

  • Entregar um modelo inicial (Starter Template) em Hydrogen para futuras vitrines:
  • Modelos de configuração de ambiente
  • Suporte para substituição de temas conforme a marca de cada região
  • Roteamento, localização e configuração de CI/CD pré-configurados
  • Estrutura de pastas escalável e alternância entre regiões


4. Integração com o CMS Kontent.ai

  • Integrar o Kontent.ai como CMS para todo o conteúdo não relacionado a produtos:
  • Utilizar as APIs GraphQL ou REST do Kontent.ai para entregar conteúdo aos componentes Hydrogen
  • Implementar blocos de conteúdo modulares gerenciados pelo CMS (Hero, Banner Promocional, Depoimentos, FAQs etc.)
  • Habilitar layouts de página dinâmicos e páginas de marketing (ex.: /sobre-nos, /sustentabilidade)
  • Integração no nível de rotas: permitir que o CMS controle navegação e estrutura de layout
  • Suporte a campos de conteúdo localizados para vitrines multilíngues e multi-regiões
  • Implementar funcionalidade de pré-visualização segura para revisar atualizações de conteúdo em ambiente de testes
  • Colaborar com os responsáveis pelo conteúdo para definir e implementar modelos e fluxos de trabalho dentro do Kontent.ai

title: Staff Platform Engineer
description:
Title: Staff Platform Engineer

Business Unit: Process Manufacturing

Location: Brazil, remote

About CAI

CAI is a leading provider of digital work execution platforms designed to enhance operational efficiency and drive productivity in industrial environments. CAI’s platform leverages advanced technology to convert complex, paper-based procedures into streamlined, digital workflows. By enabling real-time data collection and integration, CAI facilitates greater visibility into work processes, allowing organizations to make informed decisions, optimize performance, and ensure compliance.


In addition to robust workflow management capabilities, CAI emphasizes data-driven insights to foster continuous improvement. CAI's solutions are tailored to address the unique challenges of industries such as manufacturing, energy, and pharmaceuticals, helping organizations achieve higher operational standards and reduce costs. With a commitment to innovation and user-centric design, CAI empowers businesses to transition from traditional practices to a modern, digital approach, driving growth and enhancing efficiency.

Come Join the CAI Team

At CAI, we pride ourselves on fostering a vibrant and inclusive culture where collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. We believe that working together across diverse teams not only drives innovation but also builds a supportive environment where everyone's contributions are valued. Our commitment to continuous learning and development is central to our ethos; we invest in career development and mentorship opportunities to help our employees thrive and expand their skill sets. With a clear focus on personal and professional growth, we offer a dynamic career path that encourages ambition and rewards dedication, ensuring that each team member has the opportunity to reach their full potential and advance within the organization.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Responsible for the execution of architecture, development, implementation and quality practices in support of delivery of Parsable’s cloud platform
  • Implementation of cloud platform, operational and architectural patterns and practices to enable key features and drive new feature development
  • Participate in the selection of technology enablers to deliver performant, reliable and cost-optimized solutions
  • Design, build, and maintain cloud platform capabilities, aligned with DevOps and operational practices to rapidly and safely deploy new features to our platform
  • Collaborate with Product, Professional Services, and other stakeholders to develop new cloud-platform features and products
  • Create technical documentation for accessing, integrating, and using Parsable platform capabilities
  • Act as a senior technical team member in the delivery of Parsable’s cloud platform; gain and consistently maintain deep knowledge of our cloud platform and implementation technologies
  • Serve as a senior technical team member and subject matter expert within the platform engineering team and the larger engineering organization
  • Improve and build observability, uptime, and readiness metrics to detect problems and maintain our SLAs with our customers
  • Implement DevSecOps tooling, processes and procedures to promote rapid iteration and reliable delivery of new and updated features
  • Deliver quality work in an agile delivery model within a team environment
  • Share your work and data engineering best practices across the organization

Skills & Qualifications

  • 8+ years experience delivering customer-facing platforms at scale
  • 5+ years experience architecting, building and releasing production-grade within a SaaS environment
  • 5+ years experience developing backend services capabilities leveraging Go and/or Node (Typescript)
  • Demonstrated, hands-on mastery of the AWS suite of tools including Lambda, API Gateway, AppSync, EventBridge, ECS, S3, DynamoDB, DocumentDB, and AuroraDB
  • Deep experience building product capabilities in a microservices architecture
  • Ability to assert and defend opinions on the merits of differing solutions
  • Ability to clearly explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences

Additional Requirements

  • Experience working in an Agile environment
  • Experience working in a global organization

title: Talent Pool - Marketplace
description:
ABOUT SHEIN:

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!


OUR MARKETPLACE:

We’re looking for passionate professionals to join our team in the SHEIN Marketplace in Brazil! The marketplace is a dynamic platform where we connect local sellers with consumers, offering a wide variety of products. If you’re excited to be part of a fast-paced, growing e-commerce environment and help drive the success of an innovative marketplace, we’d love to hear from you!


POSITIONS SUMMARY:

Account Manager: Manages and nurtures relationships with sellers, ensuring their success and satisfaction within the marketplace platform.

Hunting: Focuses on identifying and onboarding new sellers, expanding the marketplace’s range of offerings and driving growth.

Seller Service: Provides ongoing support to sellers, addressing their needs and helping them optimize their experience and performance on the platform.


REQUIREMENTS:

The requirements may change according to the position, but for Brazil Marketplace we usually look for people with:


● Bachelor's degree or above;

● Experience with Marketplace;

● Sales aptitude and ambition to constantly surpass your KPIs;

● Logical and problem-oriented thinking;

● Good analytical skill;

● Excellent communication skills;

● Proeficient in Microsoft Excel;

● Advanced English or Mandarin is a plus.


OUR VALUES:


● Customer First

● Take ownership

● Deliver Results

● Make Change

● Celebrate diversity


At Shein, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Would you like to partake in technical challenges, collaborate on an interesting product, be up to date with the latest technology, and contribute to taking our product to market? Then keep reading!


Yes, tell me more…

fullinfo is a startup B2B data services software company.

We are building an un-paralleled data collection pipeline which is being deployed on AWS and written in Go and Typescript. With a focus on innovation, quality, and accessibility, we are developing a one-stop lead generator platform.

The Customer facing part of the solution is a Typescript and GraphQL based web application. Deployed on AWS as well. Serverless paradigm is being applied: Most of our code is running as AWS’s Lambda’s.


We are currently hiring a Senior DevOps Engineer with AWS CDK knowledge for an initial 12-month B2B Contract on a remote basis. The ideal candidate will be comfortable with AWS (EDA architecture) and TypeScript and willing to pick up new technologies as needed.


Responsibilities:

  • Participate in our DevOps team
  • Ensure the quality of our AWS infrastructure
  • Develop and review infrastructure code that enhances performance and cost efficiency
  • Ensure seamless integration of all AWS services within our architecture
  • Optimize the infrastructure for continuous scalability
  • Drive ongoing improvements in CI/CD pipelines
  • Collaborate with development teams, the CTO, and technical leads


Requirements:

  • A Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum of 6 years relevant experience working in DevOps roles
  • Hands-on experience with TypeScript and AWS CDK
  • Coding experience in implementing business features
  • Familiarity with AWS services, including Lambda, API Gateway, S3, CloudFront, EventBridge, AppSync, DynamoDb, OpenSearch
  • Business-level proficiency in English


The successful candidate will…

  • Be comfortable working remotely and independently, with some overlap with HQ work schedule
  • Take ownership and be accountable for their work
  • Be eager to work on various aspects of our cloud infrastructure in a generalist role
  • Quickly familiarize themselves with our infrastructure to generate new ideas and improve our existing setup
  • Have experience supporting other teams in implementing AWS solutions
  • Adopt a proactive, hands-on approach


What can you expect from us?

  • To shape the company from the ground up – join our team as a pioneer and help us carve our way forward.
  • Together we’ll take our product to market – how cool would it be to celebrate together?A flat hierarchical structure with room for innovation in a highly motivated team.
  • A start-up environment that is passionate about quality, problem solving and building beautiful software.


Our passion stems from our shared values and mission. With that said, our culture is built on two major aspects:

Quality: At fullinfo we have show-and-tell energy, and we let the quality of our product speak for itself. We love building beautiful software and get hyped by always raising the bar on quality. Our product is beautiful inside and outside. How do we achieve this? By always asking ourselves “Is this right?” or “Does this make sense?”.

Problem Solving: We foster innovation and novel approaches to problem solving, while keeping user needs at front of mind.

  • Documentar processos, configurações e ministrar treinamentos para usuários-chave.

  • Entendimento de gestão de dados mestres e seu papel no PLM.
  • Experiência com ciclos de teste (UT, IT, UAT ).
  • Inglês avançado e/ou espanhol avançado (oral e escrito).
  • Conhecimento em aplicativos Fiori para PLM no S/4HANA.

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Software
description:
POR QUE TRABALHAR CONOSCO

A Onze é uma das nossas start-ups e está reinventando a Previdência Privada. Somos a primeira PrevTech do Brasil, trazendo uma proposta totalmente digital para um mercado tradicionalmente analógico. Acreditamos que a tecnologia e a inovação podem ter impacto real na maneira com que as pessoas se preparam financeiramente para o futuro. Além de uma empresa de tecnologia, somos também uma gestora de investimentos, com fundos de previdência privada eficientes e desenhados para trazer o melhor retorno com o menor custo possível – como a Previdência deve ser. Nossos fundos, plataforma tecnológica e soluções de saúde financeira tem como objetivo maximizar a acumulação eficiente de patrimônio, um dos maiores desafios do povo Brasileiro.


O TIME

O time da Onze é distribuído em pequenos times ágeis que valorizam a cultura onde cada pessoa desenvolvedora tem autonomia para participar de todo o processo de desenvolvimento, inclusive as etapas de concepção de ideias. Priorizamos e incentivamos que as pessoas se desenvolvam tanto tecnicamente como em outras áreas de competência como comunicação e liderança. Temos orgulho de trabalhar na primeira fintech em previdência privada do Brasil e temos a inovação tecnológica e criatividade como uma das bases do nosso dia a dia.


A OPORTUNIDADE

Você irá participar diretamente das etapas de arquitetura, desenvolvimento, testes automatizados, code review e deploy de funcionalidades em sistemas na nuvem. Você vai trabalhar com tecnologias e metodologias de ponta em aplicações que demandam alta disponibilidade, baixa latência e escalabilidade em um ambiente de desenvolvimento que prioriza eficiência, testes, qualidade e alta entrega de valor.


O QUE PROCURAMOS

  • Pessoas das áreas de Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas relacionadas que sejam proativas e apaixonadas por tecnologia;
  • Conhecimento em linguagens de programação. Ex: Go, Java, Python, C# (gostamos bastante de Go, se não souber, você pode aprender aqui!);
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados relacionais (ex: MySQL, PostgreSQL, etc);
  • Experiência em computação em nuvem (de preferência AWS);
  • Experiência em arquitetura de solução;
  • Valorizar qualidade e código limpo;
  • Conhecimento em testes automatizados;
  • Interesse em desenvolver soft skills como comunicação e liderança;
  • Inglês intermediário/Avançado


O QUE OFERECEMOS

  • Acompanhamento e gestão de carreira com ciclos de avaliação semestrais estruturados e feedbacks recorrentes;
  • Planos de Saúde e Odontológico;
  • Plano de Saúde para Pet;
  • Previdência privada;
  • Plano de saúde financeira incluindo consultorias individualizadas com profissionais certificados;
  • Benefício refeição/flexível da Swile;
  • Incentivo educacional anual em formato de reembolso;
  • Acesso à plataforma da Udemy;
  • Bônus anual de acordo com a performance;
  • Voucher ifood no mês de aniversário;
  • Gympass/Totalpass;
  • Empresa cidadã
  • Modelo CLT - remoto;

title: Training & Experience Strategy Intern
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to transform food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage. Our story began in 2023 in Hong Kong, China, where we became an industry leader in under a year. Building on that momentum, we entered Saudi Arabia in 2024 and soon expanded to over 20 cities. This year, we accelerated further, launching in Qatar, Kuwait, and the UAE within a remarkable 40-day span. Now, we've just launched in Brazil, through a pilot in Santos and São Vicente, with more destinations ahead.


What You'll Do

As the Training & Experience Strategy Intern, your work will directly impact 3PL partners' success through:

  • Training Development & Delivery:Create bite-sized, engaging training content (videos <3 mins, PDFs, infographics) for the knowledge base.Pilot and evaluate live sessions vs. self-paced learning, tracking completion rates to optimize delivery.Map the 3PL lifecycle (onboarding scaling) to identify critical training gaps.
  • Experience & Feedback Analysis:Deploy surveys (Google Forms/Typeform), analyze trends, and share actionable insights.Build an NPS dashboard (with the Data Team) and generate monthly reports to track partner sentiment.Conduct interviews with 3PLs to uncover pain points and opportunities.
  • Partner Engagement:Launch a monthly newsletter with updates, recognition (e.g., "Top 3PLs of the Month"), and feedback loops.Automate milestone reminders (e.g., birthdays, 100th order) to strengthen relationships.
  • Collaboration:Weekly syncs with the team to align training/experience initiatives with broader 3PL strategy.


What We Need From You

Core Requirements:

  • Content Creation: Proficiency in Canva, video editing tools, and Google Workspace (Docs, Slides, Sheets).
  • Data Literacy: Ability to analyze survey results, track NPS metrics, and create simple dashboards (Excel/Sheets).
  • Empathy & Communication: A knack for understanding 3PLs' challenges and translating them into solutions.
  • Project Management: Organize tasks (e.g., newsletter, training rollout) and meet deadlines autonomously.


Bonus (But Not Mandatory):

  • Logistics/3PL industry experience.
  • Notion/Confluence for documentation.
  • Fluency in Chinese/English (for broader partner reach).

title: Training & Experience Strategy Intern
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to transform food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage. Our story began in 2023 in Hong Kong, China, where we became an industry leader in under a year. Building on that momentum, we entered Saudi Arabia in 2024 and soon expanded to over 20 cities. This year, we accelerated further, launching in Qatar, Kuwait, and the UAE within a remarkable 40-day span. Now, we've just launched in Brazil, through a pilot in Santos and São Vicente, with more destinations ahead.


What You'll Do

As the Training & Experience Strategy Intern, your work will directly impact 3PL partners' success through:

  • Training Development & Delivery:Create bite-sized, engaging training content (videos <3 mins, PDFs, infographics) for the knowledge base.Pilot and evaluate live sessions vs. self-paced learning, tracking completion rates to optimize delivery.Map the 3PL lifecycle (onboarding scaling) to identify critical training gaps.
  • Experience & Feedback Analysis:Deploy surveys (Google Forms/Typeform), analyze trends, and share actionable insights.Build an NPS dashboard (with the Data Team) and generate monthly reports to track partner sentiment.Conduct interviews with 3PLs to uncover pain points and opportunities.
  • Partner Engagement:Launch a monthly newsletter with updates, recognition (e.g., "Top 3PLs of the Month"), and feedback loops.Automate milestone reminders (e.g., birthdays, 100th order) to strengthen relationships.
  • Collaboration:Weekly syncs with the team to align training/experience initiatives with broader 3PL strategy.


What We Need From You

Core Requirements:

  • Content Creation: Proficiency in Canva, video editing tools, and Google Workspace (Docs, Slides, Sheets).
  • Data Literacy: Ability to analyze survey results, track NPS metrics, and create simple dashboards (Excel/Sheets).
  • Empathy & Communication: A knack for understanding 3PLs' challenges and translating them into solutions.
  • Project Management: Organize tasks (e.g., newsletter, training rollout) and meet deadlines autonomously.


Bonus (But Not Mandatory):

  • Logistics/3PL industry experience.
  • Notion/Confluence for documentation.
  • Fluency in Chinese/English (for broader partner reach).

Mindset:

  • Curiosity to experiment (e.g., testing training formats).
  • Proactive communication to flag blockers early.

title: NetSuite Developer
description:
**To apply, kindly submit your resume in English. Please note that any other format will not be considered.**


Who we are:


Kajae is a premium staff augmentation company that connects top global talents to thriving US companies and clients offering fully remote opportunities. Our team hails from over 27 different countries, with the majority coming from the Philippines and Latin America. We pride ourselves on our tight-knit culture and strong bonds, despite working remotely across diverse timezones.


Benefits :


Competitive salary – paid in USD - Receive your compensation in US dollars, providing stability and global value for your hard work.

100% fully remote setup - Work from anywhere in the world—permanently. Enjoy the freedom and flexibility of a remote role while staying close to what matters most. No more commuting hassles, and more time for life’s important moments.

Healthy work-life balance - We prioritize your well-being. Through regular check-ins during your first few months, we offer ongoing support and career guidance. We also ensure you’re partnered with top-tier clients in a positive, healthy work environment.

Health insurance - Get covered starting your third month with us—your health and peace of mind matter.

Mental health support - Our in-house mental health professional is available to ensure you have access to the emotional and psychological support you need to thrive.

Referral bonuses - Know someone great? Refer them and earn up to USD 100 for every successful hire.

Fun virtual events - We host monthly virtual events filled with games, holiday celebrations, and exciting prizes. It’s a great way to connect and recharge as a team.

Kajae Spotlight bonus - Exceptional performance is recognized through our Kajae Spotlight program, where top performers earn cash rewards.

Kajae Tribe and rewards platform - Engage with the whole team through our internal social platform and earn coins for participating. Use them to bid in our lively auctions for prizes like AirPods, Apple Watches, Starbucks gift cards, shopping or experience vouchers, and more.

Continuing education opportunities - Access 100% free online courses through our university partners in the US. Earn academic credits that can go toward a Master’s or Graduate Degree—completely on us.

All-expense paid summits - Top performers and tenured team members may qualify to attend our exclusive annual summits. So far, we’ve held summits in Palawan, Bohol, and Boracay (Philippines), Cusco (Peru), and Punta Cana (Dominican Republic).


About the Role


We are seeking a talented NetSuite Software Developer who is passionate about building scalable, high-performing applications that integrate seamlessly across business systems. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in modern JavaScript frameworks (Vue, React, or Angular) , NodeJS backend development , and experience scripting within NetSuite . This position requires both creativity and technical depth to develop integrations, APIs, and dynamic web interfaces while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.


Responsibilities


  • Front-End Development: Build modern, responsive front-end interfaces using Vue.js (or similar frameworks such as React or Angular).
  • Back-End Development: Develop and maintain robust NodeJS services that handle data integration and automation.
  • API Integration: Design, implement, and maintain RESTful API endpoints that connect enterprise systems.
  • System Integration: Create and manage integrations between NetSuite and third-party platforms such as Business Central , QuickBooks Online , and Salesforce .
  • NetSuite Scripting: Develop and maintain SuiteScript solutions to enhance NetSuite functionality and improve workflow efficiency.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with project managers, designers, and other developers to solve complex technical challenges and ensure successful delivery.
  • Innovation: Continuously explore new technologies and methods to improve performance, scalability, and maintainability across systems.


Requirements:


  • Develop and maintain backend systems using Node.js and modern JavaScript frameworks (Vue, Angular, or React).
  • Design and implement APIs, integrations, and backend logic for enterprise solutions.
  • Work with third-party APIs and enterprise systems to ensure seamless data flow.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.
  • Candidates must have a strong foundation in NetSuite , either as a Functional Consultant or Technical Consultant .


Nice to Have


  • Familiarity with accounting concepts or financial software.
  • Experience with enterprise SaaS platforms (NetSuite, Salesforce, etc.).
  • Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure, AWS).
  • Background in ERP systems or business process automation.
  • Experience with CRM integrations and data synchronization workflows.

title: Webflow Designer
description:
SOBRE A LETS


A LETS é uma empresa de tecnologia que atua na integração de canais de venda com operadores logísticos, potencializando resultados de negócios por meio de soluções inovadoras. Nosso sistema SaaS, chamado Max, é a espinha dorsal que conecta varejistas, operadores logísticos e canais de venda de forma eficiente e automatizada, oferecendo uma experiência simplificada e eficaz para todos os envolvidos. Nossa missão é desenvolver soluções tecnológicas inovadoras que maximizem o desempenho e a eficiência dos negócios, capacitando empresas a alcançar resultados excepcionais.


Estamos crescendo rapidamente e buscamos talentos que queiram fazer parte de nossa jornada, ajudando a transformar o ecossistema de tecnologia e logística para negócios. Se você é uma pessoa com olhar apurado para produto digital, experiência do usuário e front-end em plataformas low-code/no-code como o Webflow , a LET'S é o seu lugar!


SOBRE A VAGA


Estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista de Webflow & Experiência Digital para liderar a evolução do nosso site, blog, landing pages e hubs de conteúdo — conectando marca, performance e produto em uma experiência consistente.


É um papel híbrido entre UX/UI Designer e Front-end Low-Code : alguém que entende jornada, navegação, hierarquia de informação, microcopy e conversão, mas também entra no Webflow para estruturar coleções dinâmicas, componentes, interações, integrações e ajustes finos de layout, responsividade e performance.


Você será “dono(a)” do nosso ecossistema Webflow (e ferramentas associadas), garantindo que tudo esteja organizado, escalável e fácil de manter, sempre conectado com times de Marketing, Growth, Produto e Vendas.


ATIVIDADES:


  • Arquitetura e UX do site : estruturar menus, páginas, fluxos, componentes e coleções (CMS) alinhados à estratégia da LETS e dos produtos (Max SalesCloud, Bippi, FiboNash, etc.).

title: [TEMPORÁRIA] Engenheiro de Dados - Sênior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados Sênior | Temporária

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.


Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.


Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

title: Consultor(a) Microsoft Dynamics + PowerPlatform Sênior
description:
A Inetum é uma empresa líder global em serviços de TI, dedicada a fornecer soluções inovadoras aos nossos clientes. Estamos comprometidos em promover um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, inclusivo e que preza pela diversidade, onde a criatividade e a colaboração prosperem. Estamos presentes em 19 países e somos mais de 28.000 colaboradores no mundo.


Procuramos um consultor sênior experiente em Dynamics 365 para apoiar o desenvolvimento, aprimoramento e otimização de um ambiente Microsoft Dynamics 365. Essa função envolve trabalhar em casos complexos, projetando e configurando soluções nos módulos Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Service e Customer Insights: Journeys, além de utilizar os recursos do Power Platform para automatizar processos de negócios.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Configurar e personalizar os módulos Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Service e Customer Insights: Journeys.
  • Projetar e implementar soluções usando Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps, Dataverse).
  • Desenvolver e manter integrações dual-write com Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations.
  • Apoiar migrações de dados e garantir integridade, escalabilidade e conformidade do sistema.
  • Documentar o trabalho no Jira e Confluence em um ambiente ágil.
  • Entregar soluções de alta qualidade com atenção aos detalhes e à experiência do usuário.


Qualificações

  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência prática com Dynamics 365 CE (Sales, Customer Service, Customer Insights: Journeys).
  • Forte conhecimento em configuração, personalização e design de soluções.
  • Compreensão sólida das capacidades da Power Platform.
  • Experiência com integrações (baseadas em API e dual-write) e migração de dados.
  • Familiaridade com entrega ágil e ferramentas como Jira e Confluence.
  • Certificações Microsoft relevantes para consultores sêniores de D365.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar com equipes distribuídas.
  • Experiência em consultoria ou ambientes de entrega baseados em projetos.
  • Inglês avançado/fluente.


Informações Adicionais

Horário de trabalho: 6h às 15h (fuso horário da Europa).

Alocação: Superior a 6 meses.

Estamos comprometidos em promover um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico, inclusivo e que preza pela diversidade, onde a criatividade e a colaboração prosperem. Estamos presentes em 19 países e somos mais de 28.000 colaboradores no mundo.


Procuramos um consultor sênior experiente em Dynamics 365 para apoiar o desenvolvimento, aprimoramento e otimização de um ambiente Microsoft Dynamics 365. Essa função envolve trabalhar em casos complexos, projetando e configurando soluções nos módulos Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Service e Customer Insights: Journeys, além de utilizar os recursos do Power Platform para automatizar processos de negócios.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Configurar e personalizar os módulos Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Service e Customer Insights: Journeys.
  • Projetar e implementar soluções usando Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps, Dataverse).
  • Desenvolver e manter integrações dual-write com Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations.
  • Apoiar migrações de dados e garantir integridade, escalabilidade e conformidade do sistema.
  • Documentar o trabalho no Jira e Confluence em um ambiente ágil.
  • Entregar soluções de alta qualidade com atenção aos detalhes e à experiência do usuário.


Qualificações

  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência prática com Dynamics 365 CE (Sales, Customer Service, Customer Insights: Journeys).
  • Forte conhecimento em configuração, personalização e design de soluções.
  • Compreensão sólida das capacidades da Power Platform.
  • Experiência com integrações (baseadas em API e dual-write) e migração de dados.
  • Familiaridade com entrega ágil e ferramentas como Jira e Confluence.
  • Certificações Microsoft relevantes para consultores sêniores de D365.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar com equipes distribuídas.
  • Experiência em consultoria ou ambientes de entrega baseados em projetos.
  • Inglês avançado/fluente.


Informações Adicionais

Horário de trabalho: 6h às 15h (fuso horário da Europa).

Alocação: Superior a 6 meses.

title: Data Consultant Brazil
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing

As part of the Data and Consulting team, you will help our clients transform and enhance their strategies through advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and big data, generating valuable insights for the business.

  • Innovate: You will work closely with consultants, scientists, engineers, and data analysts to understand client needs and propose innovative and strategic solutions.
  • Learn and Share: You will belong to a collaborative team where knowledge sharing is essential. You’ll have the opportunity to learn from experts and actively contribute to the team’s evolution.
  • Develop and Present Strategic Recommendations: You will be responsible for transforming data into insights, helping formulate and present recommendations that directly impact clients' business decisions.
  • Act Across the Project Value Chain: From data collection, organization, and analysis to building and implementing data-driven strategic solutions.
  • Participate in Training: You’ll acquire the essential technical knowledge for your role as a consultant and stay updated on the latest technological innovations in the market.
  • Manage Priorities and Contribute to the Team: You will learn how to structure and prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, identify risks, and suggest solutions. Additionally, you will contribute to the creation of strategic content, helping spread knowledge within the team.

What we are looking for

  • Academic Background: In Business Administration, Engineering, Economics, or related areas. More than a specific course, we value intellectual curiosity, autonomy, and dynamism.
  • Interest in Data and Business : Passion for business challenges and using Big Data and Analytics to solve real problems and drive strategic changes.
  • Analytical and Practical Mindset : Ability to understand business challenges and propose data-driven customized solutions.
  • Communication and Collaboration Skills : Ease in working in teams, sharing knowledge, and interacting with different areas and stakeholders.
  • Interest in the Digital and Technological Ecosystem : Curiosity about topics such as agile methodologies, project management, data visualization, data science, and engineering.
  • Proactivity and Entrepreneurial Spirit : You propose new ideas, seek innovations, and are always willing to learn and contribute actively to the team.

What We Offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Resource Manager, Professional Services
description:
Title: Resource Manager, Professional Services

Business Unit: Graphic Communications

Department: Customer & Professional Services

Location: Brazil, Remote

About us

Graphic Communications, a CAI Division, is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for the print industy. Graphic Communications’ integrated and automated offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With over thirty years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the packaging and printing industries, it is the company's deeply held philosophy that they succeed when its customers thrive.

Position Overview

The Resource Manager plays a critical role in ensuring Professional Services teams are properly staffed, aligned, and equipped to meet project timelines and business objectives. This role involves close collaboration with Project Managers, Project Coordinators, Regional Managers, the Sr. Director of Professional Services, Customer Success, and Sales to efficiently manage resources, balance workloads, and ensure smooth project delivery.

Core Responsibilities

Resource Planning and Allocation

  • Identify, assign, and allocate resources to ongoing and upcoming projects based on skills, availability, and priorities.
  • Maintain a real-time view of resource capacity and project needs across the organization.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for project staffing and collaborate with Sales and Regional Managers to ensure proper coverage for upcoming engagements.
  • Own all new engagements at intake and assign resources based on availability and skillset.
  • Check in regularly with Project Managers to confirm they have the resources required for project success.
  • Maintain up-to-date skills and certifications records for all consultants.Forecasting and Talent Management
  • Collaborate with Sales, Project Managers, Regional Managers, and leadership to forecast future resource requirements.
  • Identify resource gaps and recommend cross-training, recruitment, or subcontracting needs based on upcoming opportunities.
  • Support long-term workforce planning and professional development of consultants.

Process Optimization and Tool Management

  • Develop and maintain tools, dashboards, and reports to monitor utilization, productivity, and performance.
  • Establish and enforce consistent processes for resource requests and assignments to maximize efficiency.
  • Ensure data and processes remain aligned across systems.

Daily Operational Responsibilities

New Engagement Intake

  • Review new projects pushed from Salesforce into Wrike.
  • Confirm all project metadata: customer, region, product, estimated hours, and key contacts.
  • Confirm the correct Wrike template and folder structure were created.
  • If automation fails, manually create projects using Salesforce data.

Assignment & Scheduling

  • Review unassigned Wrike projects daily.
  • Match consultants to projects based on skill set, availability, and regional needs.
  • Assign both primary and secondary consultants and confirm schedules with stakeholders.
  • Flag any assignment conflicts or delays to Regional Managers or Services Leads.

System Sync and Integration Oversight

  • Cross-reference Salesforce → Wrike and Wrike → NetSuite mappings to ensure accuracy.
  • Validate billing fields (sold-to ID, billing trigger, engagement type) and confirm correct syncing.
  • Ensure Concur sync processes are updating users, vendors, and expenses accurately.
  • Monitor Wrike integration logs and escalate issues as needed.
  • Maintain field mapping and oversee sync processes across Salesforce, NetSuite, and Concur.
  • Track and resolve open integration issues in collaboration with Operations.

Time Tracking Oversight

  • Validate daily timesheet entries for all consultants.
  • Identify missing, misallocated, or excessive time entries and follow up as needed.
  • Escalate persistent noncompliance to Regional Managers.
  • Ensure adherence to time entry policies for accurate utilization and billing reporting.

Project Health & Status Monitoring

  • Monitor project dashboards in Wrike for task completion, budget consumption, and forecasted effort.

Reporting & Communication

  • Participate in regular syncs with Regional Managers.
  • Track upcoming projects, resourcing constraints, and urgent escalations.
  • Respond to inquiries regarding capacity, project swaps, or timeline adjustments.
  • Provide data for utilization, staffing, revenue forecasting, and any other Professional Services metrics.

Performance and Collaboration

  • Monitor workload balance across consultants.
  • Participate in resource reviews with Regional Managers to support continuous development based on Sales forecast.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Professional Services teams to align timelines, priorities, and dependencies.

Qualifications

Experience:

  • 4+ years of experience in resource planning or operations within a software or technology organization.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and balance resources effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Skills:

  • Strong proficiency with resource planning tools (e.g., Wrike)
  • Working knowledge of JIRA, Salesforce, required, and NetSuite preferred.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and negotiation skills.

CAI Software is an “EEO/Veterans/Disabled employer.”

Equal Employment Opportunity

CAI Software is an Equal Opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity or expression), religion, disability, , genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by local, state or federal law.

Disability Accommodation

CAI Software endeavors to make reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities and disabled veterans pursuant to applicable federal and state law. If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process or are limited in the ability or unable to access or use the online application process and need an alternative method for applying, please contact us at or send an e-mail with your specific accommodation request.

Work Authorization

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. CAI Software does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of citizenship or immigration status in accordance with the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986 (IRCA) .

Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination

CAI Software will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor’s legal duty to furnish information. 41 CFR 60-1.35(c).

Department: Customer & Professional Services

About us

Graphic Communications, a CAI Division, is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for the print industy. Position Overview

The Resource Manager plays a critical role in ensuring Professional Services teams are properly staffed, aligned, and equipped to meet project timelines and business objectives.   • Validate daily timesheet entries for all consultants.

title: UX/UI Designer
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


You’ll be working alongside our Lead Desktop Designer day-to-day, while also collaborating regularly with the larger design team, motion graphics team, and user acquisition team to bring ideas to life from wireframes to polished UIs. While the lead drives the vision, you’ll turn concepts into reality with speed, precision, and polish. You’ll also stay responsive to shifting priorities, adapt to quick turnarounds, and always design with developer feasibility in mind. This is not a research- or strategy-heavy role. We’re looking for someone who’s happy to execute, tweak, and finesse. If you love clean pixels, smooth systems, and being the reliable engine behind great product design this is your role.


Key Responsibilities


  • Translate wireframes and rough concepts into crisp, production-ready designs
  • Build and maintain high-quality UI components for browser extensions and desktop apps
  • Collaborate closely with our lead designer and developers to ensure fast, clean handoff
  • Make smart decisions about when to polish vs. when to ship
  • Adapt to shifting priorities and irregular work cadences without missing a beat
  • Keep designs tight, lean, and respectful of developer constraints
  • Bring taste and craft, even to tight-turnaround projects
  • Contribute to a shared design system and maintain consistency across platforms


Who You Are


  • 3+ years of UI/UX experience with a strong emphasis on desktop design
  • A portfolio that shows clean, dev-friendly UI work—bonus for any
  • browser-related experience or browser extension examples
  • Deep proficiency with Figma and an efficient, systemized approach to
  • design
  • Ability to take direction, iterate fast, and not get precious
  • Strong eye for detail and consistency
  • Comfort working in ambiguity and shifting strategies
  • Respect for dev workloads—your work should make their lives easier, not
  • harder
  • Reliable, communicative, and fun to work with under pressure


Nice to Have


  • Experience designing responsive layouts for desktop applications, with
  • consideration for mobile and adaptive views
  • Light working knowledge of HTML/CSS/JS (enough to understand
  • constraints)
  • Comfort using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Midjourney) for speed and
  • inspiration
  • Familiarity with accessibility and internationalization basics

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Backend – Golang
description:
A NTT DATA Inc. é uma empresa multinacional de tecnologia que integra, dentre seus serviços, o desenvolvimento de software, segurança, cloud e, principalmente, infraestrutura de TI. Estamos, segundo o Great Place to Work, dentre as melhores empresas de Tecnologia para se trabalhar no Brasil. Temos uma cultura de trabalho inclusiva e prezamos muito pela liberdade de melhorar processos, pela flexibilidade e pelo respeito às pessoas!

Para que juntos possamos fazer grandes coisas, a NTT DATA Inc. acredita e apoia a diversidade em sua totalidade. Dessa forma, nossa empresa é aberta para todos, independentemente de deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça, etnia, idade, origem ou estética.

Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Sênior com sólida experiência em Golang, para atuar em soluções de alta escalabilidade, resiliência e performance. O(a) profissional será responsável pelo desenvolvimento de microsserviços, práticas de DevOps, integração contínua e observabilidade, em um ambiente moderno baseado em Kubernetes e arquiteturas cloud-native.


Quais serão suas responsabilidades?

  • Desenvolver e evoluir APIs e microsserviços em Golang, aplicando boas práticas de arquitetura (MVC, Hexagonal, Clean Code) e realizando code reviews.
  • Garantir alta disponibilidade, testes unitários e de integração, além de atuar com CI/CD e práticas DevOps.
  • Realizar deploys e troubleshooting em Kubernetes (pods, serviços, rollouts), utilizando K9s, Splunk e Datadog para observabilidade.
  • Trabalhar com clusters gerenciados (EKS/AKS) e manifests YAML para configuração e versionamento.
  • Criar e manter Helm Charts para automação de deploys e gestão de configurações por ambiente.


O que esperamos que você possua?

  • Experiência sólida com Golang no desenvolvimento de APIs e microsserviços (mandatório).
  • Conhecimento intermediário em Kubernetes, incluindo deploy, troubleshooting e rollouts.
  • Experiência com Helm (criação, customização e manutenção de charts).
  • Vivência com EKS/AKS, YAML e pipelines de integração contínua.
  • Conhecimentos em bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL) e não relacionais (MongoDB, DynamoDB).


Como você pode se destacar?

  • Experiência com ArgoCD / Argo Workflows para automação de pipelines e releases.
  • Conhecimento em Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Crossplane ou CloudFormation).
  • Práticas de DevOps e Gitflow, com uso de GitHub Actions.
  • Experiência com mensageria (Kafka, SQS/SNS, Service Bus).
  • Vivência em ambientes cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure) e cultura de observabilidade.


O que nós oferecemos?

  • Vaga remota - Brasil
  • Contratação modelo CLT
  • Seu equipamento de trabalho
